economy.zh:
过去24小时，全球市场在多重冲击中剧烈震荡。地缘冲突（美伊在霍尔木兹海峡交火）推动原油和避险资产飙升，但美股科技股在资金轮动和内存危机中连续第五周下跌；欧洲面临德国汽车业裁员潮和特朗普关税威胁；中国经济则呈现内热外冷特征——IPO显著回暖、AI算力投资加码，但新能源车龙头发出需求预警。以下为本日关键动态：

- **[美伊冲突升级，油轮在霍尔木兹海峡被袭后美军打击伊朗目标](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/tanker-struck-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-us-iran-tensions-escalate.html)**。60天停火协议名存实亡，布伦特原油与美元同步走强，欧洲股市承压，但美股期货因停火谈判曙光而短暂反弹。
- **[美股科技板块遭遇5年最差一周，纳斯达克连跌5日](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxOTnBDU0oyQkU3QUtPWm5vYzBiLTliSWNPazJXM2UzTU9aOGFnMWJzQnRJQm00RzVKakVKbjBqVVhWckJqeF8xMW9iTUFmUXU0TTBPdGhUVHRZZG5fYzJJWEliY1MtMzVmT2FCZ2pqc2IzSDVrRGtVb2NuM1VYMTBxQW85WWhMdkl3d3JaYVpsOTBLU2s2bDN3WXZhcG5fbGNxN3FtVnNsaXlGQmphRDNxN1RuNXJ5dw)**。背后是华尔街从科技向价值/能源轮动，同时内存短缺演变为小厂商的‘生存危机’[来源](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/memory-crunch-shaking-apple-and-microsoft-existential-for-small-guys.html)。
- **[SpaceX被快速纳入纳斯达克100指数](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/spacex-added-to-nasdaq-100.html)**，将触发大规模ETF被动买入，成为纳斯达克‘快速通道’机制的首批受益者之一。但上市后股价已有所冷却，而太空经济招聘热度不减。
- **[德国汽车制造商开启历史性裁员](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQX2d5cl90UFRyMTdPNUFwVkxvN3ZvclY5UEFweF9haVEwVU92ZDBubXp1Rm1aMG9pZ093R2ltYjNJcndIMVFNN0R0T1ZnRWR5R3ZxdEFBUjhXcWIxUDVCRXlGblp2YjJEb0w0eXJISE43M1A3V1JMQVJYbmZHSVV6eTdzWWU)**，中国电动车企低价冲击全球市场，美国重卡电动化正借补贴向东南亚和非洲出口[来源](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358516/chinas-big-trucks-go-electric-and-abroad-subsidies-help-pave-road-net-zero-freight)。
- **A股IPO显著回暖，近700亿融资规模**（[同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YU21GaHVxVE5wOVRpbUZpLWlydnJNYVRTYXppVTRqVXkydkJleHMxVWhfalVNdGZuMnJtTHN5Z0pDMWpRT3FJMUlHY2ZGWlNHWmhycTB4SlFKdnJlSEE)），协创数据拟定增80亿元加码AI算力与存储[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBWYklnTEJybkZyZTdxMkZQX0V2X2NUZGNxdDR2d2sxVU9oM2hUZHE5R3lTQUo5aXoxMTN1QlNMWkxEMXJ6UmVHTG85RENONEhHVWtKNHNSTHJfUFVFNFhYaW53)，市场风险偏好回升。
- **欧洲央行委员Isabel Schnabel演讲标题‘通胀回来了吗？’**[来源](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260627~3807c2766e.en.pdf)引发关注，而全球债券投资者被建议转向加息周期不同步的非美市场[来源](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/inflation-as-major-reason-to-invest-in-global-bond-markets.html)。

**后续观察**：本周焦点将集中在美伊停火谈判能否实质推进，以及美联储年度压力测试结果是否影响银行资本分配。若地缘风险不退，能源通胀将压制全球央行降息预期；若冲突缓和，前期超跌的中国互联网股可能迎来技术性反弹。
economy.en:
Markets navigated a contradictory 24 hours, with geopolitical whiplash—a U.S. strike on Iranian targets after a tanker hit in the Strait of Hormuz, followed by futures surging on a reported U.S.-Iran deal—competing against a hawkish Federal Reserve and a deepening tech rout. The S&P 500 slid below its 50-day moving average while the Nasdaq suffered its worst week in months as Wall Street rotated out of technology. Simultaneously, a memory-chip crunch is rattling Apple and Microsoft and proving existential for smaller hardware firms, while SpaceX’s fast-track inclusion into the Nasdaq-100 promises a wave of ETF buying. In Europe, the German auto industry announced historic job cuts as Chinese EV rivals flood the market, and Trump threatened 100% tariffs on European digital-service taxes. China’s auto sector faces its own headwinds: NIO’s CEO warned of a 20% sales plunge, even as Li Auto expanded into Macao. On the positive side, Citi called beaten-down Chinese internet stocks a buying opportunity, A-share IPO fundraising hit nearly 70 billion yuan, and Hong Kong leads global ultra-rich population growth. Retail sentiment in Chinese social-media communities turned cautiously optimistic, with record-breaking private-equity fund counts and a rebound in gold and crypto prices.

- **U.S.-Iran Flashpoint:** A commercial tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting U.S. military retaliation, yet futures quickly rallied on news of a potential deal. The dueling narratives have sent oil and crypto higher, but the 60-day ceasefire framework is now in doubt. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/tanker-struck-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-us-iran-tensions-escalate.html), [Stocktwits](https://news.google.)
- **Memory-Chip Crisis:** Apple and Microsoft are raising device prices to cover soaring memory costs, but smaller consumer-electronics firms face an “existential crisis” as supply shortfalls widen. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/memory-crunch-shaking-apple-and-microsoft-existential-for-small-guys.html)
- **SpaceX Fast-Track to Nasdaq-100:** The Elon Musk company will join the index via a recently adopted fast-track inclusion rule, likely triggering massive ETF rebalancing flows. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/spacex-added-to-nasdaq-100.html)
- **Fed Stress Test Pass:** The Federal Reserve’s annual check confirmed large U.S. banks can weather a severe recession and continue lending, providing a floor for financials. [Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260624a.htm)
- **German Auto Bloodletting:** Carmakers are cutting jobs at historic rates as Chinese rivals flood the market, signaling deeper structural erosion in Europe’s industrial core. [Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQX2d5cl90UFRyMTdPNUFwVkxvN3ZvclY5UEFweF9haVEwVU92ZDBubXp1Rm1aMG9pZ093R2ltYjNJcndIMVFNN0R0T1ZnRWR5R3ZxdEFBUjhXcWIxUDVCRXlGblp2YjJEb0w0eXJISE43M1A3V1JMQVJYbmZHSVV6eTdzWWU)
- **China Auto Warning:** NIO’s CEO cautioned that overall China auto sales could drop 20% this year, even as the company maintains its own 50% growth target—a risky bet in a cooling market. [MSN](https://news.google.)
- **Chinese IPO Revival:** A-share IPO fundraising approached 70 billion yuan, with notable listings including Basic Semiconductor’s hearing pass for its AI-data-center silicon carbide (SiC) play. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YU21GaHVxVE5wOVRpbUZpLWlydnJNYVRTYXppVTRqVXkydkJleHMxVWhfalVNdGZuMnJtTHN5Z0pDMWpRT3FJMUlHY2ZGWlNHWmhycTB4SlFKdnJlSEE)

**Watch next:** The U.S.-Iran ceasefire’s fragility will keep oil and defense stocks in play; the ECB’s Isabel Schnabel speech on inflation (published today) may reshape rate expectations; and the memory shortage’s impact on consumer-electronics earnings calls next week. In China, the NIO sales warning will be a key test for the EV sector’s growth narrative, while the A-share IPO pipeline suggests capital markets are thawing despite global tech weakness.

今日全球社会新闻呈现多组剧烈震荡：地缘冲突、自然灾害与极端天气叠加共振。美伊之间新一轮互袭使海湾局势骤然升级，委内瑞拉强震已致逾1400人死亡且救援因军方封锁受阻，欧洲热浪突破历史极值影响1.5亿人口。与此同时，日韩防务合作加速推进，中俄军机再度进入韩国防空识别区；北京中心地标遭小型飞机撞击引发城市安全讨论。知乎社区围绕欧洲热浪、新能源出海和奥斯卡评委选取展开分化明显的讨论。

- **美伊冲突升级**：美国轰炸伊朗锡里克和格什姆岛后，伊朗报复性攻击巴林和科威特美军设施，特朗普威胁“从军事上完成工作”。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxdwkgqgq0o)、[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/28/iran-war-live-trump-threatens-tehran-as-us-bombs-sirik-qeshm-for-2nd-day) 双方报道形成冲突核实链。
- **委内瑞拉双震灾情持续恶化**：死亡人数升至1430人，近7万人失联，但军方禁止志愿者进入灾区，引发民愤。[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/27/venezuela-earthquakes-death-toll-rises-jorge-rodriguez)、[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l451420zo) 相互印证救援困境。
- **欧洲热浪破纪录**：德国、丹麦、捷克等国气温超35°C，约1.5亿人受影响。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2vdydz31no) 报道为跨区域现象。
- **北京中信大厦遭小型飞机撞击**：官方通报飞行员死亡、13人受伤，事件引发关于低空开放与城市安全的风险讨论。[RFI](https://news.google.) 独家披露细节。
- **日韩防务合作向AI延伸**：日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎访韩，双方同意在AI领域深化防务交流。[Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFByTmhubFptaWtDUE11NE1RMm1oMHVXS2ttbDVtN2s3UUNPM3QxZ0plZHo4Q0p2NWNvZUpkMDZmTVd4Y2RwZHY4QkZ4Y1ltd0hzZXFxRDBjMWU3UQ) 与 [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQcHYtTGtUR2VwUTN6TGpYaGpCeU9pWnp0WHU1YjhPc3V3UWNSS2V2V2t2Yl9qYVpPeVRhVHZna3VlWU9FOXBsOVU3YXZGdG03b2RZTFdoajEydlQwS0ZLb2xXTkJtNmNzMW5qUF9PNWR3a19tVlJxWHA0ajdOWWtSYmZ1X1FFbThsakN3VkRuQmQ3MnZ5ZWxZRjlGYnBhWFVRTWtiV2RWeE5yVWJIbkt3ZFNkRGJzRkFldkZIc0F6Tk8) 交叉确认。
- **中俄军机进入KADIZ**：韩国称中国和俄罗斯军机进入韩国防空识别区。[Taipei Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBDaFZSQ2RDYlk5SmFVMDNoV05qZnE3S19rOVpla3g0eTUzQTNRR20yUnI3STJIbWRUcUFRcUlDMm9kcmh0UGlBRG9MN1RxbnJQWGxDaDB0a0pxX2FBckJOMHhfYnQ5dHpyQnJ3OUxWMGFlOVdtQ2hqOA) 报道未透露更多细节，但显示东北亚空域紧张。
- **布基纳法索与法国断交**：军政府称法国损害其国家利益。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c7vymlgl5vgo) 这是西非萨赫勒地区反法浪潮的最新例证。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突若继续升温可能影响全球油价与中东航运；委内瑞拉地震的救援与政治博弈将考验马杜罗政府；欧洲热浪可能加剧能源供需矛盾；北京撞机事件将倒逼低空安全管理细则出台；日韩AI防务合作与中俄军机进入KADIZ之间的张力值得持续跟踪。

The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating US-Iran hostilities, a devastating earthquake in Venezuela with a rising death toll, and a severe European heatwave affecting 150 million people. Meanwhile, diplomatic and military maneuvers continue in East Asia, and a rare small plane crash in Beijing shocks the public.

- **US-Iran Conflict Escalates**: Iran launched retaliatory strikes at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after US bombed Iranian targets. Trump threatens to 'militarily complete the job.' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxdwkgqgq0o), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/28/iran-war-live-trump-threatens-tehran-as-us-bombs-sirik-qeshm-for-2nd-day))
- **Venezuela Earthquake Crisis Deepens**: Death toll passes 1,430 with 70,000 unaccounted for; military blocks citizens from aiding rescue efforts, fueling anger. ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/27/venezuela-earthquakes-death-toll-rises-jorge-rodriguez), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l451420zo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/28/anger-grows-in-venezuela-as-citizens-blocked-from-aiding-earthquake-rescue))
- **Europe Heatwave Breaks Records**: 150 million people face temperatures above 35°C across Germany, Denmark, Czech Republic, and France, straining infrastructure. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2vdydz31no))
- **Israel Strikes Southern Lebanon**: At least one killed a day after Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement; Hezbollah condemns. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2kpn0eeweo))
- **Bad Bunny Makes History**: The Puerto Rican star becomes the first Latin artist to headline a UK stadium in London. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dyrk56dg9o))
- **Japan-South Korea Defense Cooperation**: Defense ministers agree to continue exchanges including AI collaboration, reaffirming denuclearisation goal. ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQcHYtTGtUR2VwUTN6TGxYaGpCeU9pWnp0WHU1YjhPc3V3UWNSS2V2V2t2Yl9qYVpPeVRhVHZna3VlWU9FOXBsOVU3YXZGdG03b2RZTFdoajEydlQwS0ZLb2xXTkJtNmNzMW5qUF9PNWR3a19tVlJxWHA0ajdOWWtSYmZ1X1FFbThsakN3VkRuQmQ3MnZ5ZWxZRjlGYnBhWFVRTWtiV2RWeE5yVWJIbkt3ZFNkRGJzRkFldkZIc0F6Tk8))
- **Beijing 'China Zun' Hit by Small Aircraft**: Official report: pilot killed, 13 injured; rare urban aviation incident. ([RFI](https://news.google.))
- **AI Bubble Fears in Japan?** The Japan Times explores whether a market correction is imminent. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBRRFRwbnJxbjBsSEF2SHN5YlNKUG9aa0MwVTgxN200dGNMSmxLOENXcEx0ZXhGZU9QdDRfc1VXR1U0TDVyVDFfLTVDanFwUjZ1eDZkRTZqajZHM0NhQjRkc1Q1elVhTlBaRHJWTVZkVU9SWjh2V1UyVnVNalU0UQ))

**Watch next:** Tensions in the Middle East could escalate further with Trump's threats; Venezuela's humanitarian crisis may worsen as rescue efforts stall; the European heatwave is forecast to persist, straining power grids. Readers should monitor Iran's next moves and the international response to Venezuela's blockade of aid.

## 军事新闻简报（2026-06-28）

过去24小时，全球军事局势因美伊冲突骤然升级而进入高危阶段。美国在和平备忘录签署后首次对伊朗境内目标实施空袭，伊朗随即以无人机和导弹攻击巴林、科威特及霍尔木兹海峡船只，双方互不相让，临时停火协议名存实亡。与此同时，乌克兰持续打击俄罗斯纵深能源目标，中国周边军事动态密集，印太地区多国联合演习与新装备交付并行。

- **[美国对伊朗发动空袭](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)**：美军中央司令部确认打击伊朗导弹、无人机和雷达设施，回应此前伊朗攻击霍尔木兹海峡货轮。这是自和平备忘录签署以来的首次直接打击。
- **[伊朗报复性攻击巴林、科威特](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQd0lsTkxsYzUycnhjT19QX0N5QmZ3UXlrQVIwZWd6Q2lPd3B3TkVDREQ1cTVGVjlfZlBBWFFjLXcycDdvMnR2QWp0aHRIc0RLc0ZmUUNvV1luYjJLQzdLaEpkcThLd0VUbV9QWEZkcHZlX2pxY0NhY3loVzc5aTZxWDZ6VW9NWGk3M0FrX1JuSVlMRU9kNVlEdnVfdXp0Q01vbDBMTGZYTnRUZmRNRnhHa2JQYXBpUHRh)**：伊朗革命卫队动用无人机和导弹打击美军盟友，并下令所有船只掉头离开战区，霍尔木兹海峡航运面临中断风险。
- **[特朗普警告“军事完成任务”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1tQlYtejNqNHBNdk1hSUV4eUR3bXk5aG5TdlZ3d0VwSlRycGF1SkRvZmZ6clRHdUh3S2thZTBsZGhTbktsODllVGV5Um5tWTBmWEpaOTR5T1k5c3ZodVE)**：美国总统称可能对伊朗采取更严厉军事行动，白宫与五角大楼内部对是否扩大冲突存在分歧。
- **[乌克兰再次打击俄罗斯石油枢纽](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPaFdmbFBIOG5wTTBKcm1feTBIaVJHZHJXYVp4WXVPMG00Z3pXX1JPc3Y0YmsxamtlRlJ3M1Z6WDZacU11Tko1ejNqYjlNSnY0c2htZEhGeUlUbkVTUTRrdThIaXJ3NWd2THdjOC1oWXJwaFFBaFJJWW1WZXNFbkhlVmU3MEF6UVJmQkt5aU1JSVdQdzZUbWMtYWdsZVVORVBsNWVucmJNSkhDWWpuMEo1WVJOZHZ5WWs)**：乌军无人机第二次袭击俄罗斯伏尔加格勒地区油库和防御设施，泽连斯基称意在削弱俄军后勤。
- **[中国发布南海军事任务禁航区](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5zRFVyOW1DczRGNEJ2cG1jNW9CSENzd0tyWmFHM1ktaGxLQ05hcXQ3dkl0TE45bnBrSEZRbVBxS2VTVW9yYjVjb2xKS0JXdmhPUW5KNlFCcVZmVS1OaFdydTFOZkNiRkNwT2xxT2tPNWtlMDVCV2c)**：中国自6月28日起在特定海域执行军事任务，并公布南海蓝洞考察成果，展示维权能力。美国则将更多中企列入“中国军事企业清单”，波兰禁止中国产汽车进入军事设施，供应链安全争议升温。
- **[美日第一岛链联合施压](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBmempEWi1zYTVRRHJqcE9mZGk2MldnNV9Fc3hFRWNRRUpNRTh0eXR4ZXBWZ0xaUE91S3BqQU9CQmNEQTM5cE1feHV6dEVYeUhEdkVETHZILV8yUW8)**：美日在第一岛链加强兵力部署，被解读为针对中国的“压倒性火力”演练。同时美国在澳大利亚的军事准备规模扩大。
- **[海军动态：法国再扣俄影子船队](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker)**：法国海军在地中海拦截第五艘俄罗斯影子油轮，欧盟对俄制裁执行力度加大。美军则向委内瑞拉派遣两栖舰和C-17参与地震救援。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突已从“有限打击”滑向“局部战争”边缘。伊朗选择攻击巴林和科威特表明其有意扩大报复范围以威慑海湾国家。霍尔木兹海峡若持续受阻，全球油价将剧烈波动。乌克兰战场呈现“以空制油”新态势，俄方可能加强防空与反无人机措施。中国在南海与第一岛链的军事活动将长期化，需警惕误判风险。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have witnessed a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict, shattering the fragile peace memorandum signed earlier this month. After US airstrikes targeted Iranian missile, drone, and radar sites in retaliation for an attack on a cargo vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran retaliated with drone and missile strikes against Bahrain and Kuwait, further imperiling an interim deal. Meanwhile, the Ukraine war continues with Kyiv striking a key Russian oil hub, and naval developments in the Indo-Pacific and Europe signal ongoing force modernization and geopolitical competition. Here are the key takeaways:

- **US-Iran Escalation: A New Phase of Hostilities** – The US military struck multiple targets in Iran on Friday and Saturday, marking the first US strikes since the peace memorandum was signed. President Trump warned about Iran's fate, stating the US may 'militarily complete the job.' Iran responded by targeting US allies Bahrain and Kuwait with drones and missiles, and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ordered vessels to turn back in the Strait of Hormuz. ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed), [PBS](https://news.google.), [Politico](https://news.google.))

- **Ceasefire Under Strain: Regional Spillover** – The conflict has directly drawn in Gulf states, with Iranian drones attacking Bahrain and a ship struck in the strait. The US and Iran continue to trade attacks and recriminations, threatening the war-ending memorandum. Iran claims the US strikes violate the deal, while the US cites 'continued aggression' against shipping. ([Reuters](https://news.google.), [IntelliNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPZXdDR0tnZ1Y3Z3JtVEFwa0tGWTh3ajJYVXpaQllqSWRwUG5xU3l0UmZUVE1IME9yVjRMbm95Q1NodTIwOWN4MzFiWFN3eXh1bUJNajdVVmlqM2d6cTBWdWhfQ3RMRzY1cHUxN2hvYUptNGVrTEZpR1hoUVh3YlU2RTliNHVkSGk2cWdaWGpVTjFzRUkxcVpLOU5mNjdLV2lsLTBlOVkyVGZhOVBrVjNlZnFIMU9vZjdWeXc))

- **Ukraine Intensifies Strikes on Russian Energy Infrastructure** – Ukraine struck a key Russian oil hub for the second time in June, targeting a defence facility in the Volgograd region, as Kyiv ramps up pressure on Putin. These operations aim to disrupt Russian logistics and war funding. ([New York Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPaFdmbFBIOG5wTTBKcm1feTBIaVJHZHJXYVp4WXVPMG00Z3pXX1JPc3Y0YmsxamtlRlJ3M1Z6WDZacU11Tko1ejNqYjlNSnY0c2htZEhGeUlUbkVTUTRrdThIaXJ3NWd2THdjOC1oWXJwaFFBaFJJWW1WZXNFbkhlVmU3MEF6UVJmQkt5aU1JSVdQdzZUbWMtYWdsZVVORVBsNWVucmJNSkhDWWpuMEo1WVJOZHZ5WWs), [AnewZ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxPQTVLNHU1NlhNR0ZxNFE5NFNtRU5lemtzZlk1czFTYmpQR2N0RjViM0JIVTJZZzBhdDR3cVlDRG1YQ1JNRkl3YVlNV3V1dml2eFFvRzFoYS1YU2huSndtMGNDcGwzd19PVGRZckFuSXFoM0h6VXVfWEw2MHk0SGhYU1BGaFp2c045a3RNYV83MlR2TngzXzIwaFJGekhpSEk))

- **China: Military Drills and Escalating Tensions** – China announced a military exercise with a ban on vessel entry near its coast, while the US added Chinese firms to its 'China Military Enterprise List'. Meanwhile, US-Japan forces are sharpening capabilities in the first island chain, and US military buildup in Australia continues. ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5zRFVyOW1DczRGNEJ2cG1jNW9CSENzd0tyWmFHM1ktaGxLQ05hcXQ3dkl0TE45bnBrSEZRbVBxS2VTVW9yYjVjb2xKS0JXdmhPUW5KNlFCcVZmVS1OaFdydTFOZkNiRkNwT2xxT2tPNWtlMDVCV2c), [财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag), [风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBmempEWi1zYTVRRHJqcE9mZGk2MldnNV9Fc3hFRWNRRUpNRTh0eXR4ZXBWZ0xaUE91S3BqQU9CQmNEQTM5cE1feHV6dEVYeUhEdkVETHZILV8yUW8), [Indo-Pacific Defense FORUM](https://news.google.))

- **Naval Modernization and Deployments** – The US Navy accepted two upgraded destroyers ahead of schedule, equipped with the SLQ-32(V)7 electronic warfare suite, while two US warships are heading to Venezuela for earthquake relief. France seized a fifth Russian shadow fleet tanker, and Naval Group delivered the 4th Barracuda-class submarine. New unmanned naval systems from Ukraine and South Korea were unveiled at Eurosatory. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-navy-accepts-two-modernized-destroyers-ahead-of-schedule/), [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/amphib-uss-fort-lauderdale-lcs-uss-billings-headed-to-venezuela), [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/naval-group-delivers-4th-barracuda-type-submarine/), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/video-ukraines-massive-new-underwater-drone-sea-trident-st-1000/), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-unveils-striker-musv-family-at-eurosatory-2026/))

**Watch next:** The US-Iran conflict is at a critical juncture; watch for further strikes on Hormuz shipping or retaliation against US assets in the Gulf. Diplomatic channels appear broken, so the risk of a broader regional war remains high. Also monitor Ukraine's campaign to degrade Russian energy exports and the potential for Chinese naval exercises in the South China Sea to escalate.

tech.zh:
**导语** 今日科技新闻呈现出一幅矛盾图景：AI领域的资本信心与地缘政治博弈剧烈震荡，而开源社区则用技术追求重建确定性。Oracle遭遇2001年以来最惨一周，引发对AI投资泡沫的担忧；亚洲初创公司趁Anthropic出口禁令推出替代模型，美国AI实验室或永久失去庞大市场。同时，Ford尝试用AI替代人类工人后惨痛回撤，为自动化狂热敲响警钟。社区层面，IP Crawl项目曝光全球公开网络摄像头，引发隐私与安全讨论；Marfa公共广播电台的助眠节目意外走红。汽车领域，Mercedes展示电动重卡真实效率数据，Tesla就FSD致死案达成和解，而一款源自月球车的豪华电动Buggy Amble One以2.5万美元价格亮相。

- **[Oracle stock worst week since 2001 dot-com bust, AI financing concerns escalate](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)** — Oracle股价单周跌幅创2001年互联网泡沫以来之最，投资者对其AI基础设施巨额支出的财务可持续性产生质疑。这一信号可能波及整个AI融资生态。
- **[Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models as Anthropic’s export ban drags on](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/27/asian-ai-startups-launch-mythos-like-models-as-anthropics-export-ban-drags-on/)** — 亚洲AI初创公司推出媲美Anthropic最新模型的功能，在美国出口禁令持续下，美国AI企业可能永久失去亚洲市场。
- **[Ford hired AI and sacked humans. It backfired badly](https://www.the-independent.com/tech/ford-ai-automation-human-workers-b3003787.html)** — Ford汽车用AI替代人类工人后遭遇严重问题，不得不再度招聘。这是自动化“效率神话”的典型案例，引发社区大量讨论。
- **[IP Crawl: Living atlas of open webcams discovered on the public internet](https://ipcrawl.com/)** — 开发者通过扫描公网IP，绘制出全球开放网络摄像头的“活地图”，引发隐私与安全担忧。该项目在Hacker News上获得273点、135条评论。
- **[Mercedes posts Tesla-like efficiency hauling 36 tons through a German winter](https://electrek.co/2026/06/27/mercedes-posts-tesla-like-efficiency-hauling-36-tons-through-a-german-winter/)** — Mercedes-Benz公布80辆电动重卡实际运营数据，证明在重型运输领域也能实现接近特斯拉水平的效率，打破续航与充电基础设施的常见迷思。
- **[Apple wants permission to buy memory from a blacklisted Chinese supplier](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958707/apple-ram-buy-memory-blacklisted-china-cxmt)** — Apple请求特朗普政府允许从被五角大楼列入黑名单的中国公司CXMT采购RAM芯片，反映出全球存储芯片价格飙升对供应链的严重压力。
- **[Inside the room where the smart home industry is still betting on Matter](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958008/matter-unify-conference-csa-apple-google-amazon-samsung-smart-home-interoperability)** — 智能家居互联标准Matter推出四年后，行业仍在艰难推进。一次闭门会议透露了Apple、Google、Amazon等巨头间的合作与分歧。

**后续观察** 本周最值得关注的是AI融资信心的转向：Oracle的暴跌是否标志着资本从“砸钱买算力”转向“看回报”？与此同时，亚洲模型替代品的崛起可能加速美国AI公司“去全球化”的代价。Ford的教训则提示，企业需重新平衡AI效率与人类员工的价值。
tech.en:
The tech landscape this week is defined by mounting financial anxieties around AI spending, geopolitical supply chain shocks, and a growing tension between automation promises and human realities. Oracle's worst weekly stock performance since 2001 has rattled confidence in AI-driven valuations, while Asian startups are rushing to fill the void left by US export bans. On the hardware front, Apple's bid to buy memory from a blacklisted Chinese supplier underscores the fragility of global semiconductor supply. Meanwhile, the automotive sector saw Tesla settle its first fatal Full Self-Driving lawsuit, and Mercedes posted real-world efficiency gains from its electric semi fleet. The Hacker News community focused on privacy tools, infrastructure guides, and critical takes on government industrial policy.

- **[Oracle stock worst week since 2001 dot-com bust](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)** – AI financing fears escalate as investors question sustainability of massive capital expenditures.
- **[Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/27/asian-ai-startups-launch-mythos-like-models-as-anthropics-export-ban-drags-on/)** – Anthropic's export ban is accelerating a shift in the global AI center of gravity toward Asia.
- **[Ford hired AI and sacked humans, and it backfired badly](https://www.the-independent.com/tech/ford-ai-automation-human-workers-b3003787.html)** – A cautionary tale of automation without human oversight, with 81 points and 49 comments on HN.
- **[Apple seeks exception to buy RAM from blacklisted Chinese supplier CXMT](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958707/apple-ram-buy-memory-blacklisted-china-cxmt)** – Skyrocketing memory prices force Apple to navigate Pentagon blacklists.
- **[Tesla settles lawsuit over fatal pedestrian crash involving Full Self-Driving](https://www.engadget.com/2203211/tesla-settles-lawsuit-over-fatal-pedestrian-crash-involving-full-self-driving/)** – A 2023 Arizona death leads to settlement, raising questions about autonomous driving liability.
- **[Mercedes posts Tesla-like efficiency hauling 36 tons through a German winter](https://electrek.co/2026/06/27/mercedes-posts-tesla-like-efficiency-hauling-36-tons-through-a-german-winter/)** – Real-world data from 80 e-trucks challenges myths about heavy-duty EV viability.
- **[Inside the room where the smart home industry is still betting on Matter](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958008/matter-unify-conference-csa-apple-google-amazon-samsung-smart-home-interoperability)** – Four years on, interoperability standards remain a work in progress.
- **[Indie developers got tired of waiting for a new Star Fox, so they're making their own](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/957679/indie-developers-star-fox-games)** – Nostalgia-driven development fills a void left by major publishers.

**Watch next:** The confluence of AI investment jitters, export controls, and hardware supply chain disruptions could trigger a re-alignment in tech strategy. Keep an eye on whether US AI labs can recover lost Asian markets, and whether Apple's CXMT gambit signals a broader decoupling or a negotiated exception.

sports.zh:
## 体育新闻日报简报 | 2026-06-28

世界杯小组赛全部收官，淘汰赛32强对阵落定。过去24小时，**梅西**替补登场再破纪录，成为史上首位连续七场世界杯进球的男人，阿根廷3-1胜约旦；**英格兰**2-0艰难拿下巴拿马，小组头名晋级，但名记Phil McNulty直言“不改进就别想夺冠”；**苏格兰**主帅克拉克在小组出局后辞职，BBC专文复盘其最后一个月。虎扑社区围绕世界杯进球榜（梅西6球领跑）、MSI电竞（Faker达成100胜）以及选秀模拟热度不减。篮球方面仅有两则简讯，羽毛球新加坡公开赛出现裁判争议。以下为各子专栏详细回顾。
sports.en:
The 2026 World Cup group stage concluded overnight, setting the knockout bracket with England, Argentina, and Austria advancing amid dramatic finishes. Lionel Messi broke another record, while Scotland's Steve Clarke resigned after elimination. In esports, Faker reached a historic MSI milestone, and in basketball, Isaiah Thomas returned to the NBA in a new role. A badminton controversy in Singapore highlighted officiating debates.

- **England top Group L but concerns linger**: A labored 2-0 win over Panama, with goals from Bellingham and Kane, secured group victory, but Phil McNulty warns they must improve to win the World Cup. [[England labour past Panama](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cm2r8yg74pgo)] [[Tuchel vows bigger games](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13558439/panama-0-2-england-thomas-tuchel-vows-the-bigger-the-game-the-bigger-england-will-be-in-world-cup-knockouts)]
- **Messi makes history again**: Coming off the bench to score his sixth goal of the tournament, Messi became the first player to score in seven consecutive World Cup appearances as Argentina beat Jordan 3-1. [[Messi breaks record](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cpwek9kryj1o)] [[Sky report](https://www.skysports.com/football/jordan-vs-argentina/report/549833)]
- **Scotland's World Cup nightmare ends**: Steve Clarke resigned after Scotland exited the group stage. The nation's ill-fated campaign is analyzed by chief sportswriter Tom English. [[Clarke steps down](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yzq73x1p7o)] [[Scotland's sorry end](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yzdwz890go)]
- **Austria survive scare, Iran eliminated**: A last-gasp equalizer by Sasa Kalajdzic in a 3-3 draw with Algeria sent both Austria and Algeria through, knocking Iran out. [[Austria vs Algeria report](https://www.skysports.com/football/algeria-vs-austria/report/549832)]
- **Esports: Faker reaches 100 MSI wins**: The T1 star became the first player to achieve 100 wins in MSI history during their match against TL. [[Faker milestone](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE11dzZRZk90RV95b2xnbzRjUUR1VWx6OFdEZXdaUHJaeFI1TDE3RHYtbkpzRTVxZ3pyVzhjSzNaeVliQzBjV2l4YUJIQkRMMG9LdTlLbXJCcHpTY0xXYzBqdzd3SQ)]
- **Isaiah Thomas returns to NBA in new role**: The veteran guard is reportedly joining an NBA team in a non-playing capacity, with contract details emerging. [[Thomas return](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPVjNUUHozbEF0TkFUdVVFcHdPX0FmOE56UkpESklYV3JwblQyVU4zV29LcXA3ZTNIbUhKcjJEbTFzMEF5bE8yZWs2bFk0M3pkbGNqT0E0cnJ6dk1lRUZhV192UGMweTZpUGVzbXh1U1NrUVFjdEtVTVB5SU9nMzRhZnZNUUZyMVc0NUw4OA)]
- **Badminton controversy at Singapore Open**: The 'Pearly-Thinaah' duo (Malaysia) overcame a disputed line call at match point to win their first-round match, sparking debate over officiating. [[Singapore Open controversy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk)]

**Watch next**: England face DR Congo in the last-32 (BBC, July 1), Mexico take on Ecuador in a crucial knockout tie, and the MSI esports tournament continues with T1 vs TL. The Singapore Open badminton quarterfinals are also set.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条：Prime Video 凭借首届 Obsessed Fest 粉丝活动成功激活 YA 剧集生态，一口气续订《Every Year After》第二季，并曝出《St. Elmo's Fire》续集剧本创作中；Annecy 动画节将 2027 年荣誉主宾国授予哥伦比亚，拉美动画产业迎来高光时刻；Elon Musk 在 X 平台短暂上传 Armie Hammer 争议电影《Citizen Vigilante》，引发平台审查讨论；BTS 的「SWIM」成为第 13 首获英国银认证单曲，创韩国艺人纪录；CMG 中国影视之夜落幕，迪丽热巴与吴越同获年度电视剧女演员，黄渤拿下年度电影男演员；微博热搜则被肖战「递还奖杯」的懵懂瞬间刷屏，粉丝与路人齐呼可爱。

- [Prime Video Flexes YA Synergy As ‘Elle’, ‘Off Campus’ & ‘Every Year After’ Stars Turn Out For Inaugural Fan Event Obsessed Fest](https://deadline.com/2026/06/obsessed-fest-recap-highlights-performances-prime-video-1236968951/) — 亚马逊搭建自有流媒体粉丝宇宙，Obsessed Fest 成为内容联动试验场。
- [Annecy Names Colombia 2027 Country of Honor](https://variety.com/2026/film/global/colombia-2027-annecy-country-of-honor-1236795828/) — 世界最重要动画节首次将主权荣誉给予南美国家，哥伦比亚动画产业受国际认可。
- [Elon Musk Posts Armie Hammer’s Controversial Comeback Film ‘Citizen Vigilante’ on X](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/elon-musk-posts-armie-hammer-citizen-vigilante-1236796152/) — 平台老板亲自「投喂」争议内容，X 的审核政策再度引发质疑。
- [BTS Sets UK Record As “SWIM” Becomes Their 13th Single To Be Certified BRIT Silver](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850719wpp/bts-sets-uk-record-as-swim-becomes-their-13th-single-to-be-certified-brit-silver) — 防弹少年团在英国市场持续破圈，银唱片纪录再刷新。
- [2026CMG中国影视之夜获奖名单出炉，迪丽热巴吴越同获大奖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5jcDhGZUNpN3hhSEpKeTZEYzRWUWYtM1VlelpLNTZ3QVJTWDFPdWhvNzV5QmdTSUFLd0pQck40cG44Q3gta3R6Rk1RMHN3SjRRRTdTSUh0a3Y4Ty01d3lhOXZVOGQzUmUzYnZJaWNIanY) — 主流行业表彰百花齐放，迪丽热巴、黄渤领衔。
- [34岁演员肖战误以为奖杯要回收当场递还，为何这个懵懂瞬间引爆全网？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPZkhkWHNCbGdYVDUtS210ZXdNV2V2RHl0enlZWkw2bkFKaGhXOEhWSUVKLS1jNlZodElra1VLZV8zRDlzRXNSQjZVVUxsWng2eEZSVHNQaVdHWkMybzZUR0w1cVpGek9iYWxIb01pT25ZN2poUXF6dHc1eE9oTEFCZWJtenk) — 一枚奖杯引发的「真性情」讨论，折射流量明星与公众期待之间的微妙关系。

**后续观察：** 流媒体巨头正将「粉丝节」作为内容宣发的枢纽，Obsessed Fest 模式可能被 Netflix、Disney+ 跟进；而 X 平台在 Elon Musk 亲自下场后，其内容监管边界愈发模糊，Armie Hammer 的「归回」是否意味着流媒体发行渠道的范式转移，值得持续关注。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape over the past 24 hours has been defined by platform ecosystem building, prestigious animation accolades, and a mix of comeback narratives and political entanglements. Prime Video flexed its YA synergy at Obsessed Fest with major renewals, Annecy signaled a global shift by naming Colombia its 2027 Country of Honor, and controversial streaming moves by Elon Musk and the White House cancellation of Vanilla Ice added friction. Meanwhile, K-pop continues its relentless chart dominance and China’s CMG awards spotlighted homegrown talent.

- **Prime Video’s Obsessed Fest and YA Ecosystem**: The streamer’s inaugural fan event in Los Angeles became a launchpad for renewals of [‘Every Year After’](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/every-year-after-season-2-renewed-charlie-1236796154/) (Season 2 confirmed, based on Carley Fortune’s sequel ‘One Golden Summer’) and teases for [‘Overcompensating’](https://deadline.com/2026/06/overcompensating-benito-skinner-plays-two-roles-season-2-1236969111/) (Season 2 with Benito Skinner playing two roles). Jennifer Lopez made a surprise appearance to introduce the ‘Off Campus’ panel, underscoring Prime Video’s strategy to create a self-sustaining romance-adaptation universe.
- **Annecy Picks Colombia as 2027 Country of Honor**: The world’s most prominent animation festival recognized Colombia’s burgeoning animation industry, a significant nod that will likely boost co-production opportunities and Mifa market participation for South American studios ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/global/colombia-2027-annecy-country-of-honor-1236795828/)).
- **Nolan Advises Coogler on IMAX for ‘Sinners’**: Christopher Nolan assured Ryan Coogler that filming ‘Sinners’ on IMAX was “not crazy” – a move that ultimately earned Autumn Durald Arkapaw an Oscar for Best Cinematography. The anecdote highlights Nolan’s ongoing evangelism for the format and its impact on prestige filmmaking ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/christopher-nolan-ryan-coogler-wasnt-crazy-sinners-imax-1236969143/)).
- **‘St. Elmo’s Fire’ Sequel Script in the Works**: Rob Lowe confirmed the team is “working on” a script for a sequel more than 40 years after the original, signaling nostalgia-driven intellectual property remains a priority for Hollywood ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/rob-lowe-st-elmos-fire-sequel-script-in-works-1236969128/)).
- **Vanilla Ice Concert Canceled by White House**: The Trump-backed Freedom 250 event pulled the Grammy nominee’s set at the last minute citing “inclement weather,” making Vanilla Ice one of the few artists not to withdraw – a move that raises questions about political curation of entertainment at official celebrations ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/vanilla-ice-freedom-250-concert-canceled-inclement-weather-1236969104/)).
- **Elon Musk Streams Armie Hammer’s ‘Citizen Vigilante’ on X**: Musk uploaded the German-banned indie action film to X for 48 hours, giving Hammer’s controversial comeback a massive (but temporary) platform. The move blurs lines between social media, content distribution, and political statement ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/elon-musk-posts-armie-hammer-citizen-vigilante-1236796152/)).
- **BTS Sets UK Record with ‘SWIM’**: BTS’s 13th BRIT Silver certification makes them the first Korean artist to achieve that milestone, reinforcing their sustained cross-market penetration ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850719wpp/bts-sets-uk-record-as-swim-becomes-their-13th-single-to-be-certified-brit-silver)).
- **CMG China Film & TV Night Awards**: Dilraba Dilmurat and Wu Yue shared Best TV Actress, Huang Bo won Best Film Actor, and the event celebrated cultural exports like “new three samples” – a sign of China’s push for soft power ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE41dmZrbnFVVHYzc0N6ZWd0VEUtMmlvbUswZWJTOWxsT3ZsR0MtTmR3SjR3UER6amZ3TjdqczJCYXRoNGZ6dHdPU01jNXF0aFlJQ0p5Ry1xeC1laWdRX3A2SHFqTzNVaGo4QktwaW8wQkE)).

**Watch next**: The premiere of ‘Elle’ (Legally Blonde prequel) on July 1 featuring James Van Der Beek’s final role, the second episode of ‘Agent Kim Reactivated’ (already breaking 15% ratings in Korea), and the fallout from Musk’s momentary streaming of ‘Citizen Vigilante’ will shape the next 48 hours. Also keep an eye on the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger’s impact on CNN’s leadership.

美股.zh:
纳指连跌5天创数月最大周跌幅，科技股遭资金抛售。地缘冲突推高原油和军工，但市场关注焦点在SpaceX快速纳入指数与内存短缺的连锁反应。
- **[纳指、标普500期货因美伊停火协议消息而大涨](https://news.google.)**，但此前盘中已体现对美联储鹰派立场的忽略。**科技与能源板块形成跷跷板**，投资者需关注后续资金流向。
- **[苹果和微软提价应对内存成本飙升，小公司面临‘生存危机’](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/memory-crunch-shaking-apple-and-microsoft-existential-for-small-guys.html)**。这暴露了AI需求带来的供应链瓶颈，可能持续扰动消费电子行业。
- **[GE Vernova展示为AI数据中心建造的大型燃气轮机](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/ge-vernova-gas-turbines-ai-data-centers.html)**，xAI的Colossus和微软德克萨斯数据中心均采用——AI对能源的饥渴正在重塑电力设备投资逻辑。
- 市场判断：科技股短期仍受制于利率预期和地缘风险，但SpaceX纳入指数带来的被动买入效应和能源基建投资主题值得中长期跟踪。
美股.en:
U.S. equity markets ended a turbulent week with the S&P 500 slipping below its 50-day moving average and the Nasdaq suffering its fifth consecutive down day, driven by a broad rotation out of technology stocks. However, futures surged late Friday after reports of a potential U.S.-Iran deal, with investors temporarily brushing aside hawkish Fed signals. Within the sell-off, several structural stories demand attention: SpaceX’s accelerated entry into the Nasdaq-100 will force massive ETF buying, the memory-chip shortage is forcing Apple and Microsoft to raise prices while smaller players face an existential threat, and the Fed’s annual stress test confirmed large banks are robust enough to lend through a severe recession. Meanwhile, Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel was sworn in as a U.S. citizen, a symbolic step toward succession. Bond investors were advised to look beyond U.S. markets to countries with tightening monetary policy.

- **Market Direction:** S&P 500 slides below 50-day MA; Nasdaq worst week in months as tech rotation accelerates. [FXEmpire](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxNVE9JcUU5R1lKUmpPN2JScFBzOVNZWkpyQ3dDZWg1RG1PeldBQjJjcTBsWHBWdlJzTWF3RUl3VXRoTUpzNTB5Ym9mWFlLZkZKeXNldGtWV2RNb3UxbUQ0dUp0Ql9PNVJQQWpGeXhfRmdzR1NYeE1FOTRoRmUwSFRnV1plM1ZwMERjdzZDNlhnX1RYWUhhMHpHb1NFZVptaEcyOWtvbnR6bnlLWmNMZW9JeWNBSVNHWE5hY0FVb2tNdlBKMDI3OFItazkyUXg)
- **Geopolitical Bounce:** Futures surge on U.S.-Iran deal hopes, but the underlying conflict remains unresolved after a tanker hit. [Stocktwits](https://news.google.)
- **SpaceX Fast-Track to Nasdaq-100:** Fast-track inclusion will drive huge ETF buying demand, a rare catalyst in a defensive market. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/spacex-added-to-nasdaq-100.html)
- **Memory Crunch:** Apple and Microsoft raise prices; smaller OEMs face existential crisis. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/27/memory-crunch-shaking-apple-and-microsoft-existential-for-small-guys.html)
- **Fed Stress Test Pass:** Large banks well-positioned to weather a severe recession. [Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260624a.htm)

*Signal:* The market is caught between geopolitics and monetary tightening; the tech rotation may deepen if the Iran deal falls through, but SpaceX’s index inclusion and the memory crisis will create sharp winners and losers.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲面临内外交困：德国制造业加速崩溃，美欧贸易战（数字税）一触即发，中东冲突推高能源成本。欧元区通胀再次成为央行关注焦点。
- **[德国‘开放模式’正从优势转为弱点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNampJX0doVGVWQVYtWnZ6Y294MkNvU3hmWGVSVUR0ay1HVmpqMS1XV2ZYNjBvSXA1QWhkY1BRbFBvUjZ5QTB3SWlVWXUyWHp1a040SVFLanVpYmJWYzhpZ3B2SmZKOWptRFN4eTJKSWFfcWZOWHhOTUdVVmQzdDdHNGdDZHJNM2NWOXIzZUZOUUQtLXR4dFlxUGctWDZ0dVVtSzZlMGZOMm5GNFlkNGpaVmRn)**——WSJ分析指出，当全球保护主义兴起，德国出口依赖成为脆弱点。汽车业失业潮是直接体现。
- **[特朗普威胁对征收数字税的欧洲国家实施100%关税](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/27/trump-threatens-tariff-eu-countries-impose-digital-tax)**，剑指法国、意大利等国，可能升级为跨大西洋贸易冲突，影响科技、奢侈品等多个行业。
- **伊朗战争对全球经济的冲击波**（[Eurasia Review](https://news.google.)），结合欧洲股市当日下跌，能源危机将最先打击欧洲制造业。
- 收束判断：欧洲央行面临进退两难——通胀威胁（Schnabel演讲）与增长停滞，短期内欧元资产将继续承压，关注欧元区国债收益率曲线变化。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets face headwinds from multiple directions: a hawkish ECB, a deepening crisis in Germany’s auto industry, and the threat of a transatlantic trade war over digital taxation. ECB board member Isabel Schnabel published a speech titled "Is inflation back?" that will be parsed for rate-path clues. German carmakers announced historic job cuts as Chinese EV imports surge, while foreign funds now control the majority of Spain’s Ibex 35. On geopolitics, the Iran conflict is sending shockwaves through energy markets, with Brent crude advancing alongside the U.S. dollar, while European equities slipped. Former President Trump threatened a 100% tariff on any European country that imposes a digital services tax, raising the specter of a new trade conflict.

- **ECB Inflation Watch:** Schnabel’s speech implies inflation risks remain elevated, potentially delaying rate cuts. [ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260627~3807c2766e.en.pdf)
- **German Auto Job Cuts:** Historic layoffs as Chinese rivals flood the market—a structural shift that undermines Europe’s manufacturing base. [Financial Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQX2d5cl90UFRyMTdPNUFwVkxvN3ZvclY5UEFweF9haVEwVU92ZDBubXp1Rm1aMG9pZ093R2ltYjNJcndIMVFNN0R0T1ZnRWR5R3ZxdEFBUjhXcWIxUDVCRXlGblp2YjJEb0w0eXJISE43M1A3V1JMQVJYbmZHSVV6eTdzWWU)
- **Spain’s Ibex 35 Foreign Ownership:** Foreign funds are the real owners, raising questions about domestic control and stability. [EL PAÍS](https://news.google.)
- **Trump Threatens 100% Tariff:** On digital services taxes, targeting European countries—a replay of 2019 tensions but with higher stakes. [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/27/trump-threatens-tariff-eu-countries-impose-digital-tax)
- **Energy Shockwaves:** Brent crude and DXY rise on Iran concerns; European equities slip. [equiti.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPZjJRTFBVc0xia0tzNURfTDk3Wm9Od2ROVDYwb1VJTEV3dmMzTXd6b0xFTS1IR0JwaFotSzVYbTZGcld0ZXlxeGJxUUR1LUt4SVNnV25BQ2lBREpmVndWNHI5QVNaclFKbkduYjloSGFieFVEOV9BUUxwSllnVThGYjNGbWI1TmhUOFd4eUp5U3RiOTgyOE9tZXJ0cTVHSTZ3TDdvRUdyQklkX2xMdHZ2X3NpUVZnNTdxZWc2OEh6bw)

*Signal:* The combination of ECB hawkishness, auto industry restructuring, and a potential digital-tax trade war makes European equities vulnerable to a risk-off shift, especially if energy costs rise further.

中国经济.zh:
中国资产在外部动荡中呈现结构性分化：香港超富裕人口激增体现财富集聚，但蔚来CEO预警汽车行业可能滑坡20%；AI产业链（碳化硅芯片、算力存储）和政策驱动的新能源重卡出口成为亮色。
- **[蔚来CEO称中国车市或暴跌20%，但公司坚持50%增长目标](https://news.google.)**。这一矛盾信号暗示价格战加剧，行业洗牌期远未结束。
- **Citi建议逢低买入中国互联网股票**（[Investing.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNbWdseUZOR2I0LXJWVGV5cm8xdjVCRHp0M2NDdktzRHNXSGFja3VyVFpHV2lYeXI1UTZqaVFMLTMtUGFmYjFsVmN0YTVsSHhLQkptU190OEZ3R3pfeTJCX3F1RUlaS2pKeVIzNmtvNzBHRjBqTzlUUFp0Mng2Yl9tOV9CbTFYRVdGV0Y4V21xTk0xYy1Ud3RIeUV6ZDJvaHN5QUlwa0xHX2xBVjM2RUhnZlZaLTVnQmxWa0V6N3I5d2QzVHgwZGJnUDA1emh5Zw)），但港股和A股科技股受全球科技低迷拖累同步走弱[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxQejl6cU9IaE1xWFVsbWFSR3FpWm9ocE04MnZqSEVGMWVTXzdIZWZzbGNtcVpVQ1pjUlhhN0RnUEx0X3ppamtUVEpVd2hmeXQ5bE80cnFWNmlIUXZ3Z1duNFFsUTlwUEFldGpiV3RsVEZTT0ZLNTg4RzlfemdnZ29hUV9WTmtYVHgxaUVLaU9MTkNpbW94RzRJMWp2bXhtTDBTUG1USzNpSjc2RmozaEhxOGNZTjN6Y18tc2RBMG9GdERhYVJnRGZwRUg0YS16QQ)，估值修复需等待外部风险出清。
- **[中国芯片企业押注碳化硅（SiC）应对AI数据中心能耗危机](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-war/article/3358492/ai-pushes-data-centres-breaking-point-some-chinese-chipmakers-bet-sic)**，深圳基本半导体通过上市聆讯，标志着国产替代在宽禁带半导体领域加速。
- **[A股IPO回暖近700亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YU21GaHVxVE5wOVRpbUZpLWlydnJNYVRTYXppVTRqVXkydkJleHMxVWhfalVNdGZuMnJtTHN5Z0pDMWpRT3FJMUlHY2ZGWlNHWmhycTB4SlFKdnJlSEE)**，叠加协创数据80亿定增，反映资金向AI算力和存储方向聚集。
- 收束判断：中国经济短期受外部冲击压制，但AI基建和政策驱动的‘新三样’（新能源车、光伏、电池）正向重卡和半导体延伸，结构性机会大于总量机会。
中国经济.en:
China’s economic narrative remains bifurcated: consumer-facing sectors like autos face a sharp slowdown—NIO’s CEO warned of a 20% drop in overall China auto sales—while tech and export-oriented industries show resilience. Hong Kong continues to attract ultra-wealthy individuals, leading global cities in high-net-worth growth. Citi recommended buying beaten-down Chinese internet stocks on the dip, and A-share IPO fundraising has rebounded to nearly 70 billion yuan. Meanwhile, Chinese chipmakers are betting on silicon carbide (SiC) semiconductors to solve AI data-center power problems, and heavy-truck electrification is gaining overseas traction. On the policy front, Beijing is raising Shanghai’s offshore yuan profile, potentially competing with Hong Kong’s role.

- **Auto Market Warning:** NIO CEO says China auto sales could plunge 20%, but NIO sticks to 50% growth target—a high-risk stance. [MSN](https://news.google.)
- **Li Auto Expands:** Officially enters Macao market, continuing global footprint expansion. [EIN News](https://news.google.)
- **Citi Bullish on China Internet:** Recommends buying battered internet stocks on the dip. [Investing.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNbWdseUZOR2I0LXJWVGV5cm8xdjVCRHp0M2NDdktzRHNXSGFja3VyVFpHV2lYeXI1UTZqaVFMLTMtUGFmYjFsVmN0YTVsSHhLQkptU190OEZ3R3pfeTJCX3F1RUlaS2pKeVIzNmtvNzBHRjBqTzlUUFp0Mng2Yl9tOV9CbTFYRVdGV0Y4V21xTk0xYy1Ud3RIeUV6ZDJvaHN5QUlwa0xHX2xBVjM2RUhnZlZaLTVnQmxWa0V6N3I5d2QzVHgwZGJnUDA1emh5Zw)
- **A-Share IPO Recovery:** Nearly 70 billion yuan raised; basic semiconductor hearing passed for SiC AI play. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YU21GaHVxVE5wOVRpbUZpLWlydnJNYVRTYXppVTRqVXkydkJleHMxVWhfalVNdGZuMnJtTHN5Z0pDMWpRT3FJMUlHY2ZGWlNHWmhycTB4SlFKdnJlSEE)
- **Offshore Yuan Strategy:** Beijing raises Shanghai’s offshore yuan profile, potentially challenging Hong Kong’s role. [SCMP](https://news.google.)

*Signal:* The divergence between a slowing domestic auto market and a resurgent IPO/tech export sector suggests investors should favor China’s tech and green-transition plays over consumer discretionary names in the near term.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区情绪从上周的悲观转向局部火热，百亿级私募数量创纪录，AI算力和光刻胶成为散户追逐的热点，另一边‘章建平割肉’案例显示题材股风险仍在。
- **[百亿级私募突破140家，创纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE4yYnVOUHhQVHdnYm4zenhJODNnMUtXeUlwb2d1SVo4WG1pajRBSGUwcUI1Z1ZpYkc5SnlnU0Y4bG5GRk53eklGZldkbGVReDBZQ0ZvQmxSbzR4dkVkRnc)**。头部私募扩张意味着机构资金对A股中长期看好，但需警惕拥挤交易。
- **协创数据拟定增80亿元加码AI算力与存储**（[同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBWYklnTEJybkZyZTdxMkZQX0V2X2NUZGNxdDR2d2sxVU9oM2hUZHE5R3lTQUo5aXoxMTN1QlNMWkxEMXJ6UmVHTG85RENONEhHVWtKNHNSTHJfUFVFNFhYaW53)），若成功将成为创业板年内最大再融资，社区高度关注其AI概念持续性。
- **[300054光刻胶股股价创历史新高](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBlMVRlVTJoWnFRRk1jdklfRkd4cnNDT1Z1eVRiOVhwR1JnSFJiZ1dxay05enA0VkxJSC1vcUR1S3piOV81c3BDa2wyVXNmVlEwMk4zb0xnRzVHdVRMWWxoUTFn)**，新增批量订单驱动，验证国产半导体材料景气度。
- **[‘章建平割肉了’标签传播](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5qM2kwcnJWRGxIbHVZYzZVZUNnbHlQUm9MNnVLNktRaEJEN1FBY01MX1UzLWxsWE01Y0tsazRIWWlJYjF3QTUwb0s2bGZaMmdPV3FiN0diVGFnTXRjRGRDTmpn)**，反映明星散户在高位题材股上的亏损，暗示部分炒作退潮。
- 收束判断：社区情绪偏积极，AI和半导体主线明确，但个股波动剧烈，需警惕题材过热后的回调。关注协创数据定增后续及光刻胶产业链可否扩散。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investor sentiment, as reflected in the Tonghuashun (同花顺) community, turned cautiously optimistic over the past 24 hours. Record-breaking milestones were noted: the number of private equity funds with assets over 10 billion yuan surpassed 140. AI-centric fundraising plans attracted attention, with Xiechuang Data (协创数据) proposing an 80 billion yuan add-on to boost AI computing and storage, potentially the largest refinancing on the ChiNext this year. Stock-specific stories included '300054' (likely a photoresist stock) hitting a new all-time high on new bulk orders, while another stock saw its price halved and a well-known retail investor 'Zhang Jianping' reportedly cut losses. Broader macro themes resonated: oil prices and cryptocurrencies rallied (Bitcoin back above $60,000) on geopolitical tensions, and gold finally bounced.

- **Private Equity Record:** Over 140 '100-billion-yuan' private equity funds, a new high. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE4yYnVOUHhQVHdnYm4zenhJODNnMUtXeUlwb2d1SVo4WG1pajRBSGUwcUI1Z1ZpYkc5SnlnU0Y4bG5GRk53eklGZldkbGVReDBZQ0ZvQmxSbzR4dkVkRnc)
- **AI Fundraising:** Xiechuang Data plans 80B yuan add-on for AI computing and storage—a key test of ChiNext appetite. [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBWYklnTEJybkZyZTdxMkZQX0V2X2NUZGNxdDR2d2sxVU9oM2hUZHE5R3lTQUo5aXoxMTN1QlNMWkxEMXJ6UmVHTG85RENONEhHVWtKNHNSTHJfUFVFNFhYaW53)
- **Stock Movers:** Photoresist stock (code 300054) hits new high on bulk orders; a separate stock halves as retail legend Zhang Jianping exits. [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBlMVRlVTJoWnFRRk1jdklfRkd4cnNDT1Z1eVRiOVhwR1JnSFJiZ1dxay05enA0VkxJSC1vcUR1S3piOV81c3BDa2wyVXNmVlEwMk4zb0xnRzVHdVRMWWxoUTFn), [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5qM2kwcnJWRGxIbHVZYzZVZUNnbHlQUm9MNnVLNktRaEJEN1FBY01MX1UzLWxsWE01Y0tsazRIWWlJYjF3QTUwb0s2bGZaMmdPV3FiN0diVGFnTXRjRGRDTmpn)
- **Macro Themes in Community:** Oil, crypto (Bitcoin >$60K), and gold all rising—retail traders see these as safe havens amid Middle East tensions. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1nc0t2TFV1VDVKYTlvaTl5Z1JMbXBwMEFsN0NWS0o4dUNiM1BhdTBuZkg2Nm9PMEV2TEZWeEZmQm9rRVhVdGN3aUIzaHR5MlFfbHZrYXVpcXkwZGRtdXc), [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1WVHhKN3lsdmlmZE9aUkU2YjU5eW9BOV9oczJ0TkZFNGJoc2I2ZkE2YUpPVUNQQ29DR1FjT1B1a0VfVW00b0hUWWZ0M0dfbndtUDdMeHBTSUdidDd3cWc)

*Signal:* The community’s focus on AI fundraising and macro hedges suggests a 'barbell' strategy: betting on AI infrastructure while seeking refuge in commodities and crypto. Watch for follow-through on the Xiechuang Data issuance as a sentiment proxy for ChiNext risk appetite.

欧美.zh:
过去24小时，欧美板块呈现“冲突+灾难”双主线。美伊互袭将海湾推向新危机边缘，特朗普威胁“从军事上完成工作”；委内瑞拉双震死亡逾1400人，军方阻止民间救援引发民愤；欧洲热浪创纪录，1.5亿人经受酷暑。同时，以色列与黎巴嫩签署框架协议后仍发生空袭，布基纳法索与法国断交标志西非反法浪潮深化。

- **美伊互袭**：伊朗报复性攻击巴林、科威特美军设施，美国此前轰炸伊朗沿岸。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxdwkgqgq0o) 与 [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/28/iran-war-live-trump-threatens-tehran-as-us-bombs-sirik-qeshm-for-2nd-day) 互相印证，战争风险陡增。
- **委内瑞拉震灾**：死亡1430人，近7万人失联，但军方封锁灾区，愤怒蔓延。[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/27/venezuela-earthquakes-death-toll-rises-jorge-rodriguez) 与 [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l451420zo) 详述家庭绝望与政治紧张。
- **欧洲热浪**：德国、丹麦、捷克破纪录，1.5亿人经历35°C以上。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2vdydz31no) 指出高温对公共健康与能源系统的冲击。
- **布基纳法索断交法国**：军政府指责法国破坏国家利益。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c7vymlgl5vgo) 显示萨赫勒地区权力重组。
- **以色列空袭黎巴嫩**：框架协议签署次日即开火，至少1人死亡。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2kpn0eeweo) 考验协议脆弱性。

欧洲热浪与委内瑞拉地震的次生灾害（健康、粮食、人口流动）将长期发酵；美伊冲突若失控，则全球都得“买单”。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran conflict escalated sharply with tit-for-tat strikes, while Venezuela's earthquake death toll surpassed 1,430 amid military obstruction of rescue. Europe faces a record heatwave affecting 150 million people. Meanwhile, Bad Bunny's historic London show offers a cultural bright spot, and Israel's strike on Lebanon complicates the new framework agreement.

- **US-Iran strikes**: Iran attacks US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after US bombs Iranian coast; Trump threatens further action. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxdwkgqgq0o), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/28/iran-war-live-trump-threatens-tehran-as-us-bombs-sirik-qeshm-for-2nd-day))
- **Venezuela earthquake**: Death toll 1,430, 70,000 unaccounted; military bars citizens from aiding rescue, sparking anger. ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/27/venezuela-earthquakes-death-toll-rises-jorge-rodriguez), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp8l451420zo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/28/anger-grows-in-venezuela-as-citizens-blocked-from-aiding-earthquake-rescue))
- **European heatwave**: Records broken in Germany, Denmark, Czech Republic; France also affected. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2vdydz31no))
- **Israel-Lebanon strikes**: Israel strikes southern Lebanon day after framework agreement; Hezbollah condemns. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2kpn0eeweo))
- **Bad Bunny history**: First Latin artist to headline UK stadium in London. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dyrk56dg9o))

Closing signal: The confluence of US-Iran hostilities, Venezuela's humanitarian crisis, and Europe's heatwave creates multiple pressure points for global stability and energy markets.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块聚焦防务合作深化与区域安全张力。日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎访韩，双方确认在AI等领域扩大防务交流，并重申朝鲜半岛无核化目标。与此同时，中俄军机进入韩国防空识别区（KADIZ），为东北亚空域安全再添变数。此外，两个热带风暴席卷日本，带来强降雨。

- **日韩防务合作**：双方同意继续防务交流，包括人工智能领域。[Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFByTmhubFptaWtDUE11NE1RMm1oMHVXS2ttbDVtN2s3UUNPM3QxZ0plZHo4Q0p2NWNvZUpkMDZmTVd4Y2RwZHY4QkZ4Y1ltd0hzZXFxRDBjMWU3UQ) 与 [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQcHYtTGtUR2VwUTN6TGpYaGpCeU9pWnp0WHU1YjhPc3V3UWNSS2V2V2t2Yl9qYVpPeVRhVHZna3VlWU9FOXBsOVU3YXZGdG03b2RZTFdoajEydlQwS0ZLb2xXTkJtNmNzMW5qUF9PNWR3a19tVlJxWHA0ajdOWWtSYmZ1X1FFbThsakN3VkRuQmQ3MnZ5ZWxZRjlGYnBhWFVRTWtiV2RWeE5yVWJIbkt3ZFNkRGJzRkFldkZIc0F6Tk8) 一致报道。
- **中俄军机入KADIZ**：韩国确认中国和俄罗斯军用飞机进入其防空识别区。[Taipei Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBDaFZSQ2RDYlk5SmFVMDNoV05qZnE3S19rOVpla3g0eTUzQTNRR20yUnI3STJIbWRUcUFRcUlDMm9kcmh0UGlBRG9MN1RxbnJQWGxDaDB0a0pxX2FBckJOMHhfYnQ5dHpyQnJ3OUxWMGFlOVdtQ2hqOA) 未说明是否侵犯领空。
- **热带风暴袭击日本**：两个风暴带来强降雨，影响部分地区。[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOaWloY19Rc0RWTkRrbnQ5dkZuNGx3UzVxaHBIM1FuN1FiMHhsLWZQajEyY2FkSXI1V2tnbEJTYkZPQTBiakQ4bUMtN05fR3VlS09PYkhPMENJeUxuMFh2Wnp3UDBnUC0xemhGSTVMUHRRd2hYMTFJNUdNMFdrSEtjdTJKMS1WOFk0) 报道。
- **日韩高层互动**：自民党资深议员与韩国总统会面，推动关系改善。[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNSHN1c2gtVkt1RGJYZVpsNHpCd2VaaTI2QU9NNXdHbUpFeTNTNkcwNk13cmE3YmNVc0h3NlZqakRBMXFmTTBnUWowaWhubFpMblRoNG5ycEtHTnN3bHhvMlJmNHZJZjBESDVEa3VuajJxbkh4T212cERKZE5kejN2dC1MQXNzeDBERE80NGx5clVIWm8) 确认。

日韩之间安全合作正从传统议题向AI等新兴领域扩展，但中俄军机活动频次增加可能导致双方相互制约，形成“合作+威慑”双重节奏。
日韩.en:
Japan and South Korea are deepening defense cooperation, including AI, amid continued Chinese and Russian military incursions into Korean Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ). Meanwhile, two tropical storms are lashing Japan, and domestic discussions on AI bubble risks are mounting. North Korea’s leader remains silent on his mother’s controversial lineage.

- **Japan-South Korea defense cooperation**: Ministers agree to expand exchanges including AI; reaffirm denuclearisation of Korean peninsula. ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQcHYtTGtUR2VwUTN6TGxYaGpCeU9pWnp0WHU1YjhPc3V3UWNSS2V2V2t2Yl9qYVpPeVRhVHZna3VlWU9FOXBsOVU3YXZGdG03b2RZTFdoajEydlQwS0ZLb2xXTkJtNmNzMW5qUF9PNWR3a19tVlJxWHA0ajdOWWtSYmZ1X1FFbThsakN3VkRuQmQ3MnZ5ZWxZRjlGYnBhWFVRTWtiV2RWeE5yVWJIbkt3ZFNkRGJzRkFldkZIc0F6Tk8), [Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFByTmhubFptaWtDUE11NE1RMm1oMHVXS2ttbDVtN2s3UUNPM3QxZ0plZHo4Q0p2NWNvZUpkMDZmTVd4Y2RwZHY4QkZ4Y1ltd0hzZXFxRDBjMWU3UQ))
- **Chinese, Russian aircraft enter KADIZ**: Seoul reports incursion; highlights regional tensions. ([Taipei Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBDaFZSQ2RDYlk5SmFVMDNoV05qZnE3S19rOVpla3g0eTUzQTNRR20yUnI3STJIbWRUcUFRcUlDMm9kcmh0UGlBRG9MN1RxbnJQWGxDaDB0a0pxX2FBckJOMHhfYnQ5dHpyQnJ3OUxWMGFlOVdtQ2hqOA))
- **Two tropical storms hit Japan**: Heavy rains affecting parts of the country. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOaWloY19Rc0RWTkRrbnQ5dkZuNGx3UzVxaHBIM1FuN1FiMHhsLWZQajEyY2FkSXI1V2tnbEJTYkZPQTBiakQ4bUMtN05fR3VlS09PYkhPMENJeUxuMFh2Wnp3UDBnUC0xemhGSTVMUHRRd2hYMTFJNUdNMFdrSEtjdTJKMS1WOFk0))
- **AI bubble concerns**: The Japan Times questions whether overvaluation in AI threatens markets. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBRRFRwbnJxbjBsSEF2SHN5YlNKUG9aa0MwVTgxN200dGNMSmxLOENXcEx0ZXhGZU9QdDRfc1VXR1U0TDVyVDFfLTVDanFwUjZ1eDZkRTZqajZHM0NhQjRkc1Q1elVhTlBaRHJWTVZkVU9SWjh2V1UyVnVNalU0UQ))
- **Kim Jong Un’s mother mystery**: BBC explores how her background could threaten regime legitimacy. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpvp3xn489no))

Closing signal: The deepening Japan-ROK defense alignment and continued KADIZ incursions underscore heightened security concerns in Northeast Asia, while weather and market risks add domestic pressure.

中国.zh:
中国社会新闻中，最受瞩目的突发事件是北京中信大厦“中国尊”遭小型飞机撞击，官方通报1死13伤，低空安全问题引发广泛讨论。此外，物流数据公布前5月社会物流总额超146万亿元，显示经济运转平稳；教育领域出现两则“正能量”报道（美润童心、一对一倾听），同时中国援坦桑尼亚医疗队继续开展义诊，反映民间外交的延续。

- **北京撞机事件**：小型飞机撞击“中国尊”，飞行员死亡、13人受伤。[RFI](https://news.google.) 独家披露。
- **物流数据**：1-5月社会物流总额超146万亿元，需求平稳增长。[Sina finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE9XZTZlV1ZQNVE1RHZ2OVJmelU1V2lfSE9tRlczdERlQnJvbWJRXzZiNm5KUDdoQWZTb2RLU1VmMVA2cnYzWE5vUmQ2NWVYbHZlVV9MVFh2cXNGb2JvaXQ1MjlhUjFMVzN3dkNuQ05rcFFGUkZDZWtxUQ) 提供宏观视角。
- **援坦桑尼亚医疗队义诊**：中国医疗队在坦桑尼亚开展义诊活动。[人民网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBwVWhHN29LZmtHamRsU0gwVkNOWGRLQW9TOWRRLTNyZVFVR3BzbDlyREJ0bzRzYzczNkxIRmxpTnFGalhkSUdtS29VQ0g4X2hLeko2dnZOT19BRHVIeU1GUE53WnZ5ZVF3QW9uYg) 体现持续医疗外交。
- **全国律协表态**：强调拥护党的领导，做党和人民满意的好律师。[thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1HalpsTjM4OUpXZ1FFQmMyYnZYWWh1WENHQ2VyTzdWTXJtU2dNSktjcTlWVDZNTEhQR1J5Q2RESlBSU1RMUXZDVU1nRlRKVUJMcDBKNndmLU94Y3I2Q3JTbw) 显示行业政治导向。
- **历史回顾**：一篇关于1952年高校整顿的复盘文章引发关注。[风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9yWE5IMGY5NDVOVTY4TG5qb3pNS3dWZUlab0xsZG9ESWExTlUwU1VJRFFyTFVoM1pPWGVDQXdmOVVTTG5WNzR5cDhkdFQ5TllqZE11Q1N5OUpZOUk) 属小众但具知识性。

北京撞机事件是今日最大变量，其调查结果将影响低空空域管制政策。物流数据则从侧面反映中国经济韧性，但与舆论场的部分情绪存在温差。
中国.en:
China’s domestic news cycle features a rare small aircraft collision with Beijing’s iconic 'China Zun' skyscraper, updates on logistics growth, and ongoing educational and medical aid initiatives. The passing of a former top academic official is also noted.

- **Beijing 'China Zun' plane crash**: A small aircraft hit the skyscraper; pilot killed, 13 injured. Official investigation underway. ([RFI](https://news.google.))
- **Logistics growth**: China's total social logistics value exceeded 146 trillion yuan in the first five months of 2026, indicating steady economic activity. ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE9XZTZlV1ZQNVE1RHZ2OVJmelU1V2lfSE9tRlczdERlQnJvbWJRXzZiNm5KUDdoQWZTb2RLU1VmMVA2cnYzWE5vUmQ2NWVYbHZlVV9MVFh2cXNGb2JvaXQ1MjlhUjFMVzN3dkNuQ05rcFFGUkZDZWtxUQ))
- **Medical team in Tanzania**: Chinese medical team conducts free clinic in Tanzania, part of ongoing international aid. ([People's Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBwVWhHN29LZmtHamRsU0gwVkNOWGRLQW9TOWRRLTNyZVFVR3BzbDlyREJ0bzRzYzczNkxIRmxpTnFGalhkSUdtS29VQ0g4X2hLeko2dnZOT19BRHVIeU1GUE53WnZ5ZVF3QW9uYg))
- **Education and party history**: Stories on education reforms and the 15th Party Congress historical retrospective dominate state media. ([China Education News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5fdVBNdmlLUEV3cUxMRi10U2UxZDdsa054MmhUZXJncFhVMUtRX3ZfSkNsR2ZjQkN2U2gtNjAzQVJmTVE1THlmbjEzS2tQM1dYZmktMzZtRWhmMkh1RVlQeF9BTmZHTnZtTGN3), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5BeHVkYzhpWElyYl9sTGNQT2p3S0huNkQzUFJsUFREM1dDT2s4MEo3aVpxTy0zVVVqYVczbUVNLUpUTzh5SjJwWUhKbzkwenpUcE5zcEhvbXBfR1UwcTBUM0RFTkVKeGI2Z2RqdkdSTTRKQ0dzTk5EWkt0OWF6dw))
- **Passing of Wang Luolin**: Former vice president of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and party secretary of Xiamen University died. ([Phoenix](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5VVEpTUmRpbnB1dWFreUgzQWFNUjlENjg5c1RWaElTUFc4eklxbmQ3cXJ6UnE2OGVpY2owbWFNb0lNaUlXTVBPcg))

Closing signal: The Beijing plane crash raises aviation safety and urban security questions, while logistics data suggests economic resilience; overseas medical missions underscore soft power efforts.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日话题呈现“情绪分化”特征：欧洲热浪引发“到底热不热”的争论，折射出国内外信息差；新能源出海话题以长安启源Q05视频为载体，讨论中国汽车产业全球竞争力；奥斯卡新评委名单却让三四线年轻人比一线城市更激动，背后是文化消费下沉与身份认同的转向。

- **欧洲热不热争议**：一则源于新浪新闻的讨论引爆知乎，用户对欧洲热浪影响范围、媒体叙事产生分歧。[新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1kSXR6RkhVR2VlaE9RbzBNekFPVUY2cVp4VE9OMm1BRFZqVFk5YkZwMk1SWG9zd0oyNUxYUDh3ZUZ3Qm1hS2d0ZUYzVmR6aDZSLXQwbFRSX2NpVWswaDJIREtSOA) 成为引信。
- **新能源出海**：长安启源Q05视频讨论中国新能源车如何打入海外市场，涉及技术、品牌与贸易壁垒。[汽车之家](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE44ZjJFYzVZOWJuazBqQU9ZNnRKYUhSbjVNWkpIeTdYaWZ0b3gzMk5fc2R0OFhVVGdWazlJQTRpYkppdjBCb0FuVU55SHFMQzZ0WWUwTXhGaEpXc1k) 内容切中产业热点。
- **奥斯卡新评委名单**：三四线年轻人更激动，预示文化话语权下沉，与主流影视圈产生张力。[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFBZeUwyZk1iMlJ4N3JiOExQVXRYZzRiYVczek9YejFNSFk0WmE0OURNYmRYaUN1dWJfQmdkZ09sSTVNeGU1by1LNUtYaXhBRzQ) 剖析动机。

知乎社区今日讨论显示，用户对国际新闻的认知鸿沟、对产业升级的务实关注以及文化消费重心下沉，共同构成一个“分裂又活跃”的舆论场。
