国际安全.zh:
## 国际安全

美伊冲突是过去24小时全球安全头号焦点。美国打破和平备忘录对伊朗动武，伊朗迅速用无人机和导弹打击巴林、科威特，并威胁霍尔木兹海峡航运。特朗普公开表态“可能军事完成任务”，双方均无退让迹象。

- **[美国首次对伊朗境内打击](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)**：美军称打击目标是伊朗导弹、无人机和雷达设施，源于伊朗攻击霍尔木兹海峡货轮。
- **[伊朗反击巴林、科威特](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQd0lsTkxsYzUycnhjT19QX0N5QmZ3UXlrQVIwZWd6Q2lPd3B3TkVDREQ1cTVGVjlfZlBBWFFjLXcycDdvMnR2QWp0aHRIc0RLc0ZmUUNvV1luYjJLQzdLaEpkcThLd0VUbV9QWEZkcHZlX2pxY0NhY3loVzc5aTZxWDZ6VW9NWGk3M0FrX1JuSVlMRU9kNVlEdnVfdXp0Q01vbDBMTGZYTnRUZmRNRnhHa2JQYXBpUHRh)**：革命卫队命令所有船只掉头，海峡实际被部分封锁。
- **[特朗普警告升级](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1tQlYtejNqNHBNdk1hSUV4eUR3bXk5aG5TdlZ3d0VwSlRycGF1SkRvZmZ6clRHdUh3S2thZTBsZGhTbktsODllVGV5Um5tWTBmWEpaOTR5T1k5c3ZodVE)**：白宫暗示更大规模报复，但未明确红线。
- **[伊朗称美方违反备忘录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPZXdDR0tnZ1Y3Z3JtVEFwa0tGWTh3ajJYVXpaQllqSWRwUG5xU3l0UmZUVE1IME9yVjRMbm95Q1NodTIwOWN4MzFiWFN3eXh1bUJNajdVVmlqM2d6cTBWdWhfQ3RMRzY1cHUxN2hvYUptNGVrTEZpR1hoUVh3YlU2RTliNHVkSGk2cWdaWGpVTjFzRUkxcVpLOU5mNjdLV2lsLTBlOVkyVGZhOVBrVjNlZnFIMU9vZjdWeXc)**：德黑兰指责华盛顿破坏外交进程，为后续停火制造障碍。

**收束判断**：当前冲突已接近“代理人战争”门槛，伊朗选择打击美国盟友而非直接攻击美军，意在测试美国反应。若美军继续扩大打击，伊朗可能封锁霍尔木兹海峡，引发全球能源危机。
国际安全.en:
The 国际安全 desk is dominated by the renewed US-Iran hostilities, with the US conducting a second wave of airstrikes and Iran retaliating against Bahrain and Kuwait. The crisis threatens the interim peace deal and has triggered warnings from President Trump about 'militarily completing the job.' Other items include US Navy destroyer upgrades, humanitarian relief for Venezuela, and the USAF seeking a long-range missile.

- **US-Iran Cycle of Violence** – The US struck multiple targets in Iran on June 27-28, following an Iranian attack on a cargo vessel in Hormuz. Iran responded by targeting US allies, while Trump warned of possible 'complete' military action. ([The Guardian](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9lWFF2NkdBMkRfMWlZR2N6YThqUWw2aFZHLXdZdWVWT3FBajgxX0hDVFhlN1otSlRsU0p2ZWl1WE5ob2d2cTJSU1d5TjNPblNxbDVmV3RYZTBERGg5Mm1iR014Y05zXzBlTE9CbVlwTGM), [New York Post](https://news.google.))
- **Escalation Spreads to Gulf States** – Iranian drones and missiles struck Bahrain and Kuwait, the first direct attacks on US allies in the Gulf. ([The Korea Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQd0lsTkxsYzUycnhjT19QX0N5QmZ3UXlrQVIwZWd6Q2lPd3B3TkVDREQ1cTVGVjlfZlBBWFFjLXcycDdvMnR2QWp0aHRIc0RLc0ZmUUNvV1luYjJLQzdLaEpkcThLd0VUbV9QWEZkcHZlX2pxY0NhY3loVzc5aTZxWDZ6VW9NWGk3M0FrX1JuSVlMRU9kNVlEdnVfdXp0Q01vbDBMTGZYTnRUZmRNRnhHa2JQYXBpUHRh0gG-AUFVX3lxTE1wYkh5dnlmY3J6Sy1DdnVjQ2RfZk1adTFVWVFtSTQ4OU0teWJfeHFfVldJQ3dUTGNWemZzWGZUWklyNW4wX0FleVVOQXcyaGp0Z1NlaVV1WV9tTk9LX1Q4Yk5KR2I5eFgyRTdOV19aOHRnaDBrcWJoZmJQOGpGbnJ2TFlibXJjdkJXQ3FmdVhsUnlHckxfN1p1UmdWZVQzZHZwb1hrNjRHc1hVdGt1eEI1Y0Q5ZWhkRzVZbUF2bFE), [Politico](https://news.google.))
- **Humanitarian Relief and Force Movements** – The US is deploying C-17s and two warships to Venezuela for earthquake aid, while the USAF is seeking a new 1,150-mile missile. ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/c-17-globemaster-iii-jets-flowing-to-caribbean-for-venezuela-earthquake-relief-effort), [Interesting Engineering](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxQQ1puS1RTMzlNc0xKQzBYak42WmxWV0pWN0NzczRiUFFNRnVMNmdUMkJUdWlJM3dieFRuNXZEZjB3bGJHZ0hWU0VKckFaWmlWOEl1SksxS0NMTy1qV0JLemR0UkRtOE8wWUJ5aW9vRTRlODVSa1BqTzRxMmQ2bzdJaHFTb0g4ZkE))

**Signal:** The US-Iran confrontation is now a multi-front crisis; further attacks on energy infrastructure or US forces in the Gulf are likely, making diplomatic resolution increasingly difficult.

冲突局势.zh:
## 冲突局势

除中东外，乌克兰战事呈现新特点：乌军无人机连续第二次攻击俄罗斯伏尔加格勒地区的石油枢纽，意图系统消耗俄能源储备。土耳其外长强调乌克兰和平对区域安全的关键性，但冲突仍无缓和迹象。同时，伊朗战争重塑全球权力格局的效应开始显现。

- **[乌克兰再炸俄石油设施](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPaFdmbFBIOG5wTTBKcm1feTBIaVJHZHJXYVp4WXVPMG00Z3pXX1JPc3Y0YmsxamtlRlJ3M1Z6WDZacU11Tko1ejNqYjlNSnY0c2htZEhGeUlUbkVTUTRrdThIaXJ3NWd2THdjOC1oWXJwaFFBaFJJWW1WZXNFbkhlVmU3MEF6UVJmQkt5aU1JSVdQdzZUbWMtYWdsZVVORVBsNWVucmJNSkhDWWpuMEo1WVJOZHZ5WWs)**：乌克兰无人机击中伏尔加格勒地区油库和国防设施，泽连斯基称这是对俄能源体系的“持续压制”。
- **[土耳其外长谈乌克兰和平](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE8wX3pKa2NVTG40bkRXazhrUnVoenFPUktoZ2R4WkU0N29MM1RjdW5JZHZvSUdFdkZpSDZXTG1LZUEwYktjbnBpOTExVWREcmxWVVFBWlJYdGs)**：强调乌克兰和平关乎地区稳定，但未提出具体新方案。
- **[伊朗战争重塑全球权力格局](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNYi1YZV9VTjdRZHhuRjFtMFJYTENlZnBEYURFN1ZMWmdJZG9OZlc2VXpVam9ITjd3SGF1T0Q1QUliemVjcnFiM0t6V2JnT01GSmdwemI0elNRc01HMVF3M3ZpNnl2Rllwdl9udTZYTHJacTNzblN0Nl9MY1hSdlZ4b2hvMWNzeDNLSkZNcVhWSDhxWkFsaEFheU03VFVOb1dyNHZlUkR1VHU4cTQ4WVQzS0xqVQ)**：分析认为美伊冲突迫使地区国家重新站队，海合会内部产生裂痕。
- **[霍尔木兹海峡替代路线讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNNE1fMzFiSjhrOFpJV21kajdMYkJEd20zcGM4Sm0yREpWU09IZnBwX0VyUk9LTWlHYWhDYXZCOS04eng0d1lPdVlKX2pZUjFwYzAwZkM4NWlDazVaSUFfRHlLaTczenpiZTdrb0lXd09XZTRiWHpNVGYxcDRjaHhoZ3JvcVFtb1VZM29raVc4RE9kUXBZWVdkbmktRU5FbV9hb1Fweg)**：能源界开始评估绕过海峡的替代管道和海运路线，但短期内难以实现。

**收束判断**：乌克兰与中东两场冲突相互牵动全球注意力与资源。俄罗斯可能借美伊对峙在乌克兰战场加大攻势，而伊朗冲突若持续，将减少美国对乌克兰的军援能力。
冲突局势.en:
The 冲突局势 desk highlights the escalating Iran conflict as a global power recast, with regional alliances being tested. Ukraine continues to strike Russian oil infrastructure, and Turkey emphasizes peace in Ukraine as key to stability. The disruption in the Strait of Hormuz is forcing alternative energy routes.

- **Iran War Recasts Global Power Dynamics** – The conflict is reshaping alliances as the US and Iran trade blows, with Gulf states caught in the crossfire. ([slguardian.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNYi1YZV9VTjdRZHhuRjFtMFJYTENlZnBEYURFN1ZMWmdJZG9OZlc2VXpVam9ITjd3SGF1T0Q1QUliemVjcnFiM0t6V2JnT01GSmdwemI0elNRc01HMVF3M3ZpNnl2Rllwdl9udTZYTHJacTNzblN0Nl9MY1hSdlZ4b2hvMWNzeDNLSkZNcVhWSDhxWkFsaEFheU03VFVOb1dyNHZlUkR1VHU4cTQ4WVQzS0xqVQ))
- **Ukraine's Deep Strikes –** Kyiv hit a Russian oil hub in the south for the second time in June, targeting a Volgograd defence facility. ([New York Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxPaFdmbFBIOG5wTTBKcm1feTBIaVJHZHJXYVp4WXVPMG00Z3pXX1JPc3Y0YmsxamtlRlJ3M1Z6WDZacU11Tko1ejNqYjlNSnY0c2htZEhGeUlUbkVTUTRrdThIaXJ3NWd2THdjOC1oWXJwaFFBaFJJWW1WZXNFbkhlVmU3MEF6UVJmQkt5aU1JSVdQdzZUbWMtYWdsZVVORVBsNWVucmJNSkhDWWpuMEo1WVJOZHZ5WWs), [AnewZ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxPQTVLNHU1NlhNR0ZxNFE5NFNtRU5lemtzZlk1czFTYmpQR2N0RjViM0JIVTJZZzBhdDR3cVlDRG1YQ1JNRkl3YVlNV3V1dml2eFFvRzFoYS1YU2huSndtMGNDcGwzd19PVGRZckFuSXFoM0h6VXVfWEw2MHk0SGhYU1BGaFp2c045a3RNYV83MlR2TngzXzIwaFJGekhpSEk))
- **Hormuz Disruption –** Alternative routes for Middle East oil and gas are being considered as the strait remains a flashpoint. ([EnergyNow.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNNE1fMzFiSjhrOFpJV21kajdMYkJEd20zcGM4Sm0yREpWU09IZnBwX0VyUk9LTWlHYWhDYXZCOS04eng0d1lPdVlKX2pZUjFwYzAwZkM4NWlDazVaSUFfRHlLaTczenpiZTdrb0lXd09XZTRiWHpNVGYxcDRjaHhoZ3JvcVFtb1VZM29raVc4RE9kUXBZWVdkbmktRU5FbV9hb1Fweg))
- **Turkish FM: Peace in Ukraine Key** – Turkey's foreign minister stressed that resolving the Ukraine conflict is essential for regional stability. ([TRT World](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE8wX3pKa2NVTG40bkRXazhrUnVoenFPUktoZ2R4WkU0N29MM1RjdW5JZHZvSUdFdkZpSDZXTG1LZUEwYktjbnBpOTExVWREcmxWVVFBWlJYdGs))

**Signal:** The confluence of Iran and Ukraine conflicts is straining global energy markets and alliance structures; expect continued volatility in oil prices and naval deployments in key chokepoints.

中国军情.zh:
## 中国军情

中国在南海与第一岛链的军事存在进一步强化。今日起执行南海军事任务，禁止船只驶入，同时官方高调公布蓝洞科考成果，强调维权能力。外部压力同步上升：美国新增“中国军事企业清单”，波兰以“间谍车”为由禁止中国产汽车进入军事设施。

- **[南海军事任务禁航](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5zRFVyOW1DczRGNEJ2cG1jNW9CSENzd0tyWmFHM1ktaGxLQ05hcXQ3dkl0TE45bnBrSEZRbVBxS2VTVW9yYjVjb2xKS0JXdmhPUW5KNlFCcVZmVS1OaFdydTFOZkNiRkNwT2xxT2tPNWtlMDVCV2c)**：自6月28日起，解放军在特定海域组织实弹或演习，外界推测与反潜或两栖作战有关。
- **[蓝洞考察展示科考与维权结合](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE9pRUJ6OEZPWU1YXzZsUFEyY2l3QUptcDJTUGI0eF9hS1Z0MGQ3WDEyVU9JRnZhM3BFem5EaGNKQXllb0dsUTgwOA)**：中国通过蓝洞发现强化南海主权主张，回应美国“非法海洋主张”指控。
- **[美将更多中企列入军事清单](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)**：商务部回应称坚决反对，将采取必要措施。清单扩大可能影响相关企业融资与供应链。
- **[波兰禁中国产汽车入军事设施](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPMFRWeGFDVERONVZEUldaQmtQejlWc0tkbDhNV0x3YS1YSzVuY2FWLW0xVEZ4ZmFQY2hqamZTWG9kQS1HdEpxd25Kc29HUGN2eEoxN0tQb3FBUEVxa2FfMGJERHhocTdGZ1J1RWNuSmdrdHZyQVNmWTJaVXBKLXFCU0RTZWczTE4xODJxSU9n)**：以网络安全为由，波兰成为首个明确禁止中国电动汽车进入军事区域的欧洲国家，恐引发效仿。
- **[美日第一岛链“磨刀”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBmempEWi1zYTVRRHJqcE9mZGk2MldnNV9Fc3hFRWNRRUpNRTh0eXR4ZXBWZ0xaUE91S3BqQU9CQmNEQTM5cE1feHV6dEVYeUhEdkVETHZILV8yUW8)**：美军与日本自卫队联合演练“压倒性火力”，意在威慑中国对台海或东海行动。

**收束判断**：中国在南海的军事活动与外部反制措施同步升级，形成“行动-反应”循环。短期内，中国将继续以维权之名强化存在，而西方可能通过更多技术封锁和供应链限制施压。
中国军情.en:
The 中国军情 desk reports on China's military exercises in the Yellow Sea, US blacklisting of Chinese firms, and growing Sino-US tensions in the Indo-Pacific. Poland has banned Chinese-made vehicles from military facilities, and analysts discuss Japan's remilitarization.

- **China Conducts Military Exercise –** A warning was issued for a military task area with a ban on vessel entry, likely in the Yellow Sea. ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5zRFVyOW1DczRGNEJ2cG1jNW9CSENzd0tyWmFHM1ktaGxLQ05hcXQ3dkl0TE45bnBrSEZRbVBxS2VTVW9yYjVjb2xKS0JXdmhPUW5KNlFCcVZmVS1OaFdydTFOZkNiRkNwT2xxT2tPNWtlMDVCV2c), [thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HWmlFMGJjckxmNVRUYXZLbm9ERk5leWdvZDFxa2VrRnBwaU0xSjN3WmxiWEQ3X3F0dk9ncEdFQkhMekVjbEV1WUdPZWFacE1oa25yU1czcVQ0NkdSTmc))
- **US Adds Chinese Firms to Military List –** The US Commerce Department placed several Chinese companies on the 'China Military Enterprise List,' prompting a response from Beijing. ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag))
- **Japan Remilitarization Debate –** A US expert noted that Asia's other nations are not afraid of Japan's military buildup, with implications for regional power balance. ([搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPeFNNZUFPR2FfcFZlV3hWSFlta1A3VHR5TVB3UVZRQWpGallCRXlGa1pEYXJRZUpXSXg0SEhhN2JyRy1TcXhWRDNzZkk5RHVZUURJT1ItSGhuWENtcndfTlEtWHZrWFRCRkJJR0pZbWQ5Z0tobkkzVjl1eGI5bE03eHo4c0VKbTZzMHhnVw))
- **Poland Bans Chinese Cars –** Citing espionage risks, Poland banned Chinese-made vehicles from entering military facilities. ([朝鮮日報中文版](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPMFRWeGFDVERONVZEUldaQmtQejlWc0tkbDhNV0x3YS1YSzVuY2FWLW0xVEZ4ZmFQY2hqamZTWG9kQS1HdEpxd25Kc29HUGN2eEoxN0tQb3FBUEVxa2FfMGJERHhocTdGZ1J1RWNuSmdrdHZyQVNmWTJaVXBKLXFCU0RTZWczTE4xODJxSU9n))
- **US-Australia Military Buildup –** US military preparations and deployments in Australia continue to expand, a direct hedge against China. ([Indo-Pacific Defense FORUM](https://news.google.))

**Signal:** China's military posture is hardening amid US-led encirclement; watch for further drills near Taiwan or the South China Sea as Beijing tests US resolve during the Iran crisis.

海军与印太.zh:
## 海军与印太

全球海军动态活跃。美军两艘驱逐舰完成电子战升级后提前交付；法国第五次扣押俄罗斯影子油轮；美国向委内瑞拉派遣两栖舰参与地震救援；乌克兰与韩国在巴黎防务展上展示新型无人水面/水下作战平台，无人海军趋势加速。

- **[美驱逐舰完成SLQ-32(V)7升级](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-navy-accepts-two-modernized-destroyers-ahead-of-schedule/)**：USS Chung-Hoon和USS James E. Williams提前交付，加强电子战能力，应对反舰导弹威胁。
- **[法国扣押第五艘俄影子油轮](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker)**：在地中海拦截MT Deliver号，马克龙亲自宣布，显示欧盟对俄制裁执行力度加大。
- **[美军两栖舰赴委内瑞拉救灾](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/amphib-uss-fort-lauderdale-lcs-uss-billings-headed-to-venezuela)**：USS Fort Lauderdale和USS Billings搭载人道物资前往，C-17运输机同步空运。此举兼具援助与政治施压双重意图。
- **[乌克兰巨型水下无人艇亮相](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/video-ukraines-massive-new-underwater-drone-sea-trident-st-1000/)**：Sea Trident ST-1000 XLUUV在巴黎展出，可执行远程打击和侦察任务，乌克兰非对称战力再升级。
- **[韩华推出Striker MUSV无人艇](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-unveils-striker-musv-family-at-eurosatory-2026/)**：中型无人水面艇可搭载导弹，韩华瞄准国际军贸市场。

**收束判断**：海上无人系统和电子战成为当前海军竞赛焦点。美法在制裁执法与快速部署上的表现，显示出传统海军强国仍主导规则执行；而乌克兰和韩国的创新则表明中小国家正通过无人技术改变海上力量平衡。**
海军与印太.en:
The 海军与印太 desk covers significant naval developments: US destroyer upgrades, warships deploying for Venezuela, French seizure of a Russian shadow fleet tanker, new submarine deliveries, and the unveiling of autonomous naval systems at Eurosatory.

- **US Navy Accepts Modernized Destroyers –** USS Chung-Hoon and USS James E. Williams were delivered ahead of schedule with the SLQ-32(V)7 electronic warfare suite. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-navy-accepts-two-modernized-destroyers-ahead-of-schedule/), [Defence Industry Europe](https://news.google.))
- **Venezuela Relief Deployment –** USS Fort Lauderdale (LPD-28) and USS Billings (LCS-15) are heading to Venezuela for earthquake aid, alongside Air Force cargo aircraft. ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/amphib-uss-fort-lauderdale-lcs-uss-billings-headed-to-venezuela))
- **French Seize Shadow Fleet Tanker –** The French Navy intercepted the MT Deliver off Sicily, the fifth such seizure of a Russian shadow fleet vessel. ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker))
- **Naval Group Delivers 4th Barracuda SSN –** The De Grasse was handed over to the French Navy, joining the nuclear-powered attack submarine fleet. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/naval-group-delivers-4th-barracuda-type-submarine/))
- **New Unmanned Naval Systems –** Ukraine unveiled the Sea Trident ST-1000 XLUUV, while Hanwha showcased the Striker MUSV missile-capable surface drone at Eurosatory. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/video-ukraines-massive-new-underwater-drone-sea-trident-st-1000/), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-unveils-striker-musv-family-at-eurosatory-2026/))

**Signal:** The naval landscape is shifting rapidly with force modernization (US, France) and the rise of unmanned systems; the US Navy's ability to project power is being tested by simultaneous crises in the Gulf and the Indo-Pacific.

AI.zh:
**概览** AI板块今日呈现出“资本恐慌”与“技术替代竞赛”并存的格局：Oracle股价暴跌引发对美国AI融资环境的质疑，而亚洲初创公司借Anthropic出口禁令推出竞品，美国AI领头羊可能永久失去海外市场。社区讨论则聚焦于AI对工作与生活的实际影响——Ford的AI替代惨案、硅谷员工的AI焦虑都是例证。

- **[Oracle stock worst week since 2001 dot-com bust](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)** — 投资者担忧Oracle对AI数据中心的大额投资难以快速产生回报，该股引发的负面情绪可能蔓延至其他重资产AI公司。
- **[Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/27/asian-ai-startups-launch-mythos-like-models-as-anthropics-export-ban-drags-on/)** — 多家亚洲AI初创公司发布声称具备类似Anthropic Mythos模型能力的模型，利用美国对华出口限制窗口期抢占市场，美国AI实验室可能“永远不会收复这个巨大市场”。
- **[Ford hired AI and sacked humans. It backfired badly](https://www.the-independent.com/tech/ford-ai-automation-human-workers-b3003787.html)** — Ford用AI自动化取代人力后遭遇效率下滑、客户投诉等问题，被迫重新招聘。该案例在Hacker News上获得81点、49条评论，引发对AI替代边际成本的深入讨论。
- **[AI Is Making Silicon Valley Productive, Anxious and Afraid to Log Off](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-26/ai-anxiety-is-fueling-burnout-across-silicon-valley-s-tech-workers)** — Bloomberg报道硅谷技术工人在AI工具提升效率的同时，因害怕被取代而无法下班，导致职业倦怠加剧。
- **[Trump administration restricts access to advanced AI models](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOcjl4UlotOWQxTkU1eno5dHktSWVyNjlSblJ3bnhySmJJSUg3Zjh6cVE0VFZ6Smo0QmRZQ0VhMm0weGNWal9wYklMd2hadENKbFJ2OFZOSE5uN2ZONGItMUtIZU9teTdfdUprMzhUcWVGcXJvNUs5RGNCY0trNHlkQ0JNNm82THB3TFFnNlVEY3lBY04yNnZ2QWlha3dCeFhE)** — 特朗普政府进一步收紧先进AI模型的访问权限，可能与上述出口禁令形成联动，导致全球AI技术分裂加剧。

**收束判断** 当资本市场的疑虑与地缘封锁同时作用，美国AI产业的“双刃剑”效应显现：一方面限制了中国获取技术，另一方面也催生了强大的海外竞争对手。Ford的案例则提醒业界，AI自动化并非万能解药，实际部署需谨慎评估系统性风险。
AI.en:
AI news this week is dominated by two forces: financial anxiety over massive spending and geopolitical fragmentation of model access. Oracle's stock rout is a canary in the coal mine for AI financing, while Asian startups are rapidly building alternatives to US models banned for export. Meanwhile, real-world consequences of AI deployment—from Ford's botched automation to worker burnout—are drawing increasing scrutiny.

- **[Oracle stock worst week since 2001 dot-com bust](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)** – Investors are questioning the ROI of AI infrastructure buildouts.
- **[Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models as Anthropic's export ban drags on](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/27/asian-ai-startups-launch-mythos-like-models-as-anthropics-export-ban-drags-on/)** – New models promise parity without US regulatory risk; the window for American labs to reclaim this market is closing.
- **[Ford hired AI and sacked humans. It backfired badly](https://www.the-independent.com/tech/ford-ai-automation-human-workers-b3003787.html)** – The backlash (81 points, 49 comments on HN) underscores the gap between AI capabilities and operational reliability.
- **[Trump administration restricts access to advanced AI models](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOcjl4UlotOWQxTkU1eno5dHktSWVyNjlSblJ3bnhySmJJSUg3Zjh6cVE0VFZ6Smo0QmRZQ0VhMm0weGNWal9wYklMd2hadENKbFJ2OFZOSE5uN2ZONGItMUtIZU9teTdfdUprMzhUcWVGcXJvNUs5RGNCY0trNHlkQ0JNNm82THB3TFFnNlVEY3lBY04yNnZ2QWlha3dCeFhE)** – A further tightening of export controls, potentially accelerating Asian independence.
- **[AI Is Making Silicon Valley Productive, Anxious and Afraid to Log Off](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-26/ai-anxiety-is-fueling-burnout-across-silicon-valley-s-tech-workers)** – The human cost of AI-driven productivity pressure is leading to burnout across tech.

The bifurcation between US export controls and Asian innovation, combined with real-world failures of AI replacement, signals a critical inflection point for AI adoption and investment.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
**概览** 今日Hacker News社区展现出对“底层技术排查”和“另类趣味”的双重偏好。IP Crawl项目曝光全球开放摄像头，引发隐私与安全讨论；Marfa Public Radio的助眠节目意外获得109点，体现社区对非主流内容的兴趣。此外，社区还关注了Polestar被美国监管机构叫停而沃尔沃幸免的争议，以及AMD Strix Halo RDMA集群部署指南等硬核内容。

- **[IP Crawl: Living atlas of open webcams](https://ipcrawl.com/)** — 该项目通过扫描公网IP发现超过百万个未加密的网络摄像头，形成实时地图。获得273点、135条评论，是当日社区最热话题。评论中既有对技术实现的赞赏，也有对隐私滥用的担忧。
- **[Marfa Public Radio Puts You to Sleep](https://www.marfapublicradio.org/podcast/marfa-public-radio-puts-you-to-sleep)** — 德克萨斯州一家公共电台的助眠播客意外走红，以慢速朗读当地新闻和天气帮助听众入睡。获得109点、30条评论，被认为是一种反算法推荐的“白噪音”创新。
- **[Feds Killed Polestar and Spared Volvo. That Should Terrify You](https://www.thedrive.com/news/feds-killed-polestar-and-spared-volvo-that-should-terrify-you)** — 美国监管机构叫停Polestar的进口，但允许沃尔沃继续销售，文章指出监管选择可能基于政治而非安全，引发83点、55条评论的激烈辩论。
- **[AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide](https://github.com/kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-vllm-toolboxes/blob/main/rdma_cluster/setup_guide.md)** — 一份详细的AMD Strix Halo平台搭建RDMA集群的指南，获得85点、13条评论。社区用户认为这是构建低成本AI推理集群的实用方案，反映了对AMD硬件的兴趣。
- **[Choosing a Public DNS Resolver](https://evilbit.de/dns-resolver-guide.html)** — 一篇关于如何选择公共DNS解析器的详细指南，获得108点、31条评论。内容涉及隐私、性能、家庭过滤策略等，体现了社区对基础设施安全的持续关注。

**收束判断** 社区今日的焦点从“发现意外漏洞”到“实用硬核指南”，再到“监管争议”，显示出技术人特有的警惕性与好奇心。IP Crawl项目尤其值得关注，它可能推动更多关于物联网设备安全审计的讨论和法规完善。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community this week engaged deeply with practical infrastructure guides, privacy tools, and critical perspectives on government intervention in the tech industry. Top stories included a massive crawl of publicly accessible webcams, a detailed guide to AMD's Strix Halo cluster setup, and a provocative opinion on the federal decision to let Polestar fail while saving Volvo.

- **[IP Crawl: Living atlas of open webcams discovered on the public internet](https://ipcrawl.com/)** – 273 points, 135 comments. A sprawling project mapping unsecured webcams raises massive privacy and security implications.
- **[Feds Killed Polestar and Spared Volvo. That Should Terrify You](https://www.thedrive.com/news/feds-killed-polestar-and-spared-volvo-that-should-terrify-you)** – 83 points, 55 comments. A scathing critique of industrial policy favoring established players over newcomers.
- **[AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide](https://github.com/kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-vllm-toolboxes/blob/main/rdma_cluster/setup_guide.md)** – 85 points. Practical guide for building a low-cost AI inference cluster using AMD hardware.
- **[Marfa Public Radio Puts You to Sleep](https://www.marfapublicradio.org/podcast/marfa-public-radio-puts-you-to-sleep)** – 109 points, 30 comments. An innovative podcast format that turns slow radio into a sleep aid.
- **[Choosing a Public DNS Resolver](https://evilbit.de/dns-resolver-guide.html)** – 108 points, 31 comments. In-depth comparison of privacy, speed, and reliability trade-offs.

This week's community pulse shows a strong appetite for practical deep-dives, privacy tools, and critical analysis of government intervention in tech markets.

科技产品.zh:
**概览** 科技产品领域，Teenage Engineering为采样器发布重磅固件更新；智能家居标准Matter四周年后的现状令人反思；Apple因存储芯片涨价寻求从中国黑名单企业采购，折射供应链压力；此外，任天堂《星狐》粉丝自制游戏、Ayaneo新款掌机等也吸引了关注。

- **[Teenage Engineering adds lo-fi mode, USB audio, and more to its KO II sampler](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/958723/teenage-engineering-os-25-ep-133-ko-ii-sampler)** — 固件2.5版本为EP-133 KO II采样器带来音频USB、可调采样率（用于Lo-fi效果）、采样倒放、琶音器等功能，最大采样长度从20秒大幅延长。这款329美元设备的可玩性再次提升。
- **[Apple wants permission to buy memory from a blacklisted Chinese supplier](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958707/apple-ram-buy-memory-blacklisted-china-cxmt)** — 据Financial Times报道，Apple向特朗普政府申请豁免，以从被国防部列入黑名单的CXMT采购RAM芯片。此举背景是全球存储芯片价格暴涨，而CXMT是少数可大量供货的厂商之一。该申请若被批准可能引发政治争议。
- **[Inside the room where the smart home industry is still betting on Matter](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958008/matter-unify-conference-csa-apple-google-amazon-samsung-smart-home-interoperability)** — Matter标准发布四年后，行业仍未大规模普及。The Verge的报道揭示了CSA联盟内部会议上Apple、Google、Amazon等巨头在认证、固件升级等方面的分歧，但各方仍表示长期投入。
- **[Indie developers got tired of waiting for a new Star Fox, so they’re making their own](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/957679/indie-developers-star-fox-games)** — 多名独立游戏开发者因对任天堂多年未推出新作感到失望，开始自行开发精神续作。文章采访了多个项目，展示了社区如何用现代引擎复刻经典玩法。
- **[Ayaneo's new horizontal handheld is an even better remake of the Game Boy Micro](https://www.engadget.com/2203185/ayaneo-new-horizontal-handheld-is-an-even-better-remake-of-the-game-boy-micro/)** — Ayaneo Pocket Micro 2采用横版设计，配备更大电池、改进的按键和3.5mm耳机孔，定价尚未公布，但被视为Game Boy Micro的现代升级版。

**收束判断** 科技产品行业正经历两大张力：一是供应链政治化（Apple与CXMT），二是小众市场通过固件更新或粉丝创作来延长硬件生命周期。Matter的进展缓慢表明，智能家居标准化仍需更务实的策略。
科技产品.en:
Consumer tech news this week is heavily centered on supply chain stress, smart home standardization, and the enduring appeal of nostalgia-driven hardware and software. Apple's attempt to bypass blacklist restrictions to secure memory chips highlights the acute pressure on hardware margins. Meanwhile, the Matter smart home standard is still trying to prove its worth four years after launch, and indie developers are stepping in where Nintendo won't.

- **[Apple wants permission to buy memory from a blacklisted Chinese supplier](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958707/apple-ram-buy-memory-blacklisted-china-cxmt)** – The request to the Trump administration underscores skyrocketing RAM prices and the entanglement of tech supply chains with geopolitics.
- **[Inside the room where the smart home industry is still betting on Matter](https://www.theverge.com/tech/958008/matter-unify-conference-csa-apple-google-amazon-samsung-smart-home-interoperability)** – Four years after launch, interoperability remains a work in progress; the conference reveals both hope and frustration.
- **[Teenage Engineering adds lo-fi mode, USB audio, and more to its KO II sampler](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/958723/teenage-engineering-os-25-ep-133-ko-ii-sampler)** – The $329 sampler continues to evolve with significant software updates, demonstrating the value of post-purchase support.
- **[Indie developers got tired of waiting for a new Star Fox, so they're making their own](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/957679/indie-developers-star-fox-games)** – A wave of fan-made projects fills a decades-long gap from Nintendo, powered by decompilation tools and community passion.
- **[Are smart bulbs more expensive to run than standard LEDs?](https://www.engadget.com/2202949/are-smart-bulbs-more-expensive-to-run-than-standard-leds/)** – The convenience of smart bulbs comes with a small but real premium on standby power consumption.

The intersection of hardware supply chains, nostalgia-driven indie development, and ongoing smart home standardization efforts will shape the consumer tech landscape in the coming months.

汽车.zh:
**概览** 汽车板块今日聚焦电动化实际表现：Mercedes公布重型电动卡车在冬季的实测效率数据，力图打破续航迷思；Tesla就2023年亚利桑那州致死事故达成和解，FSD责任问题再受关注；Rivian R2的更多细节曝光，而Apple与Audi前员工创立的豪华电动Buggy以2.5万美元定价切入高端度假村市场，设计灵感源自月球车。

- **[Mercedes posts Tesla-like efficiency hauling 36 tons through a German winter](https://electrek.co/2026/06/27/mercedes-posts-tesla-like-efficiency-hauling-36-tons-through-a-german-winter/)** — Mercedes-Benz基于80辆eActros 600电动重卡的实际运营数据，证明在36吨负载、德国冬季条件下仍能实现约1.2 kWh/km的能耗，接近特斯拉Semi的早期数据。该报告旨在反驳“电动重卡不实用”的常见质疑。
- **[Tesla settles lawsuit over fatal pedestrian crash involving Full Self-Driving](https://www.engadget.com/2203211/tesla-settles-lawsuit-over-fatal-pedestrian-crash-involving-full-self-driving/)** — Tesla就2023年亚利桑那州一起导致行人死亡的FSD事故达成庭外和解。案件细节未公开，但此举可能影响监管部门对FSD的审查力度。
- **[2026 Rivin R2: Everything We Know](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOcWhOdjBYQ2h2dC1vTlcteTM1M0UwN2JUdHFyT21Mc0FXX0Z5dnI4V05SWFpXMXN4a0l6SWdrdVFZVFJLNE1weUdEcldFbF81SU9Xd25EdlN1SWVqR1ZQMlF6UTNOMFlIT0p6Y09ReC12c1Y3ZGJRRmpWdXFSc0dPUlBZcw)** — InsideEVs汇总了Rivian R2的所有已知信息，包括预计售价约45,000美元、续航超过300英里、2026年交付。该车型被视为Rivian打入大众市场的关键。
- **[Apple and Audi alumni have made a luxe EV based on the moon buggy](https://arstechnica.com/cars/2026/06/apple-and-audi-alumni-have-made-a-luxe-ev-based-on-the-moon-buggy/)** — 初创公司Amble推出“Amble One”，一款源自月球车设计的电动越野车，面向豪华度假村，起售价仅25,000美元。采用开放式双座布局，可合法上路，定位独特。

**收束判断** 电动重卡领域的真实数据有助于行业建立信心，而Tesla和解案则暗示FSD的法律风险尚未消散。Rivian R2和Amble One分别代表了主流与细分市场的创新方向。
汽车.en:
The automotive sector this week saw a mix of encouraging efficiency data, a landmark autonomous driving settlement, and a quirky new EV concept. Mercedes released real-world performance figures from its electric semi fleet that rival Tesla's, while Tesla settled its first fatal FSD lawsuit. A $25,000 moon-buggy-inspired EV from ex-Apple and Audi employees offers a glimpse into luxury resort mobility.

- **[Mercedes posts Tesla-like efficiency hauling 36 tons through a German winter](https://electrek.co/2026/06/27/mercedes-posts-tesla-like-efficiency-hauling-36-tons-through-a-german-winter/)** – Data from 80 e-trucks under harsh conditions challenges myths about heavy-duty EV viability.
- **[Apple and Audi alumni have made a luxe EV based on the moon buggy](https://arstechnica.com/cars/2026/06/apple-and-audi-alumni-have-made-a-luxe-ev-based-on-the-moon-buggy/)** – The Amble One is street-legal, priced at $25,000, and targets luxury resort fleets.
- **[Tesla settles lawsuit over fatal pedestrian crash involving Full Self-Driving](https://www.engadget.com/2203211/tesla-settles-lawsuit-over-fatal-pedestrian-crash-involving-full-self-driving/)** – Settlement of a 2023 Arizona incident could set a precedent for autonomous vehicle liability.
- **[2026 Rivian R2: Everything We Know](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOcWhOdjBYQ2h2dC1vTlcteTM1M0UwN2JUdHFyT21Mc0FXX0Z5dnI4V05SWFpXMXN4a0l6SWdrdVFZVFJLNE1weUdEcldFbF81SU9Xd25EdlN1SWVqR1ZQMlF6UTNOMFlIT0p6Y09ReC12c1Y3ZGJRRmpWdXFSc0dPUlBZcw)** – New details emerge about Rivian's mass-market SUV.

The shift towards commercial EV viability, combined with the first major FSD settlement, signals a maturing but still risky electric vehicle market.

足球.zh: 世界杯进入淘汰赛阶段，多条关键线头浮现：**梅西**在3-1胜约旦的比赛中第7场连续进球（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cpwek9kryj1o)），刷新历史；**凯恩**成为英格兰队史世界杯射手王（12球），距离克洛泽16球的纪录还差4个（[分析](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cly9kp827ndo)）。**英格兰**2-0胜巴拿马但表现平庸（[Phil McNulty评论](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cg4wnp592z1o)），图赫尔放话“比赛越大英格兰越强”（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13558439)）。**苏格兰**告别世界杯，克拉克辞职（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yzq73x1p7o)），BBC体育首席记者Tom English撰文总结“一个不幸的故事终结”（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yzdwz890go)）。此外，奥地利3-3逼平阿尔及利亚，最后时刻绝平晋级，伊朗遭淘汰（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/algeria-vs-austria/report/549832)）。整体来看，英格兰若想走远必须提升中场控制力，而梅西的状态持续威胁冠军格局。
足球.en:
The World Cup group stage ended with dramatic developments: England qualified as group winners after a functional but unconvincing 2-0 win over Panama, while Argentina cruised past Jordan behind Lionel Messi's record-breaking goal. Scotland's 0-3 group exit led to manager Steve Clarke's resignation, and Austria survived a last-gasp scare to advance alongside Algeria, eliminating Iran. The knockout bracket is now set, with England to face DR Congo and Argentina awaiting their opponent.
- **England's win and warning**: Goals from Bellingham and Kane secured top spot, but analysts say toothless attack must improve. [[England vs Panama](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cm2r8yg74pgo)] [[McNulty warning](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cg4wnp592z1o)]
- **Messi's historic streak**: Scored his sixth goal of the tournament, setting a record for consecutive World Cup games with a goal (7). [[Messi video](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cpwek9kryj1o)]
- **Scotland's Clarke resigns**: After a 1-3 loss to Senegal sealed their fate, Clarke stepped down. [[Clarke timeline](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8mqmg327vo)]
- **Austria's dramatic draw**: A 3-3 thriller with Algeria saw both teams advance; Kalajdzic's 90+5' equalizer was crucial. [[Austria report](https://www.skysports.com/football/algeria-vs-austria/report/549832)]
- **Upcoming**: England vs DR Congo (BBC, last-32), Mexico vs Ecuador on July 1. [[Schedule](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3vy1ynv34ko)]

Closing: The knockout stage promises high stakes; watch for England's response to criticism and Messi's continued brilliance.

虎扑社区动态.zh: 社区热度集中世界杯与电竞两大模块。世界杯小组赛进球榜更新，**梅西6球领跑**，维尼修斯、哈兰德、登贝莱、姆巴佩各4球紧随其后（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBqUXdLaWV5RnlNS1JGY3owVDJnUUlwS1oxT05SbTA5UHBOSHk0OVFwOWpMVHRTdGhMNWh1amFTV3RNNDNnRU5senJQWTFMTXNiMTFEcG1jLW1JdEJMb0lXQmhGZw)）。淘汰赛对阵继续出炉：墨西哥vs厄瓜多尔7月1日开球（[qq.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1UWHNGRUN3S2RLdVZkOEYxdkY3Sk12WnExWkx0ckdnNG9MSjNDblVRSVl4dUUyYlc3TkFiVno0TkpEWWV3ZHN3NjNqM0lwSkFRNUJLRl96TQ)）。电竞方面，**Faker**在MSI达成历史首位100胜选手（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE11dzZRZk90RV95b2xnbzRjUUR1VWx6OFdEZXdaUHJaeFI1TDE3RHYtbkpzRTVxZ3pyVzhjSzNaeVliQzBjV2l4YUJIQkRMMG9LdTlLbXJCcHpTY0xXYzBqdzd3SQ)），T1辅核Keria获对阵TL次局MVP（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5oMjlBaWpweFd4M2xoNlpXNlZTVFVkdm5udlVSc1dsOUVQRnQ3UGJ6RVM4SzNabWJvZmhCWDdGTURlYnNGVW1KNDZhZmdhSjIxbi14ZGNudXRER2d6bEJlMHQ0UQ)）。此外，虎扑选秀大会球员追踪页面上线（[MSN](https://news.google.)），球迷可参与模拟选秀。社区讨论的碎片化反映了多线赛事并行的信息狂欢。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Chinese sports communities are buzzing with World Cup goal charts and esports milestones. Messi leads six goals, while Faker made history in MSI with 100 career wins. T1's Keria earned MVP honors in a group stage win. The虎扑 draft game also launched, engaging fans.
- **World Cup scoring leader**: Messi tops with 6 goals, followed by Vinicius, Haaland, Dembele, Mbappe at 4. [[Scoring chart](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBqUXdLaWV5RnlNS1JGY3owVDJnUUlwS1oxT05SbTA5UHBOSHk0OVFwOWpMVHRTdGhMNWh1amFTV3RNNDNnRU5senJQWTFMTXNiMTFEcG1jLW1JdEJMb0lXQmhGZw)]
- **Faker's MSI milestone**: First player to reach 100 wins in MSI history. [[Faker 100 wins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE11dzZRZk90RV95b2xnbzRjUUR1VWx6OFdEZXdaUHJaeFI1TDE3RHYtbkpzRTVxZ3pyVzhjSzNaeVliQzBjV2l4YUJIQkRMMG9LdTlLbXJCcHpTY0xXYzBqdzd3SQ)]
- **T1 vs TL**: Keria's Renata Glasc performance earned him MVP in game 2. [[Keria MVP](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5oMjlBaWpweFd4M2xoNlpXNlZTVFVkdm5udlVSc1dsOUVQRnQ3UGJ6RVM4SzNabWJvZmhCWDdGTURlYnNGVW1KNDZhZmdhSjIxbi14ZGNudXRER2d6bEJlMHQ0UQ)]
- **虎扑 draft game**: Fan engagement tool tracking potential NBA draft picks. [[Draft tracker](https://news.google.)]
- **Knockout match set**: Mexico vs Ecuador on July 1. [[Matchup](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1UWHNGRUN3S2RLdVZkOEYxdkY3Sk12WnExWkx0ckdnNG9MSjNDblVRSVl4dUUyYlc3TkFiVno0TkpEWWV3ZHN3NjNqM0lwSkFRNUJLRl96TQ)]

Closing: Chinese fans are deeply engaged with both football and esports; the虎扑 community will likely focus on World Cup knockout drama and MSI playoffs.

篮球.zh: 过去24小时篮球资讯清淡，仅有的两条消息显示：**小托马斯**确认重返NBA，但具体职务并非球员，而是以教练或管理层身份加盟？[搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPVjNUUHozbEF0TkFUdVVFcHdPX0FmOE56UkpESklYV3JwblQyVU4zV29LcXA3ZTNIbUhKcjJEbTFzMEF5bE8yZWs2bFk0M3pkbGNqT0E0cnJ6dk1lRUZhV192UGMweTZpUGVzbXh1U1NrUVFjdEtVTVB5SU9nMzRhZnZNUUZyMVc0NUw4OA)报道“合同比较曝光”但未详细说明；另一条为[2026年6月27日竞彩篮球官方直播渠道汇总](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOdGhKdnh1NUl1TVhlRnktSlFBZXNWT0ZmMmhxMDRPdFZJVlFNLUxoX1pPVkd3MnVIXzdlUmR2QkxDVTlJeXZoYk54OV84ZktnazNQd0J6MnA3S3hiMElxbEdJU1dvUXRtREo1Q055X1ZMallkRlB1S1p4aTZ6UFJqVng4U3JiUDg4UzNOWGh5aVFJWWpQcTE4)，属赛事指引。目前NBA处于休赛期，关注点应逐步转向夏季联赛与自由市场开启。该子专栏信息密度极低，后续需关注选秀大会相关动态（虎扑已上线选秀追踪）。
篮球.en:
Two items emerged in basketball: Isaiah Thomas is reportedly returning to the NBA in a non-playing role, with contract details surfacing. Meanwhile, a comprehensive guide to betting channels for basketball on June 27 was published by Sina Sports.
- **Isaiah Thomas new role**: Not joining CBA, but returning to NBA in an off-court capacity; contract comparison leaked. [[Thomas news](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPVjNUUHozbEF0TkFUdVVFcHdPX0FmOE56UkpESklYV3JwblQyVU4zV29LcXA3ZTNIbUhKcjJEbTFzMEF5bE8yZWs2bFk0M3pkbGNqT0E0cnJ6dk1lRUZhV192UGMweTZpUGVzbXh1U1NrUVFjdEtVTVB5SU9nMzRhZnZNUUZyMVc0NUw4OA)]
- **Betting channel guide**: Sina Sports published a list of official live streaming and betting options for basketball on June 27. [[Betting guide](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOdGhKdnh1NUl1TVhlRnktSlFBZXNWT0ZmMmhxMDRPdFZJVlFNLUxoX1pPVkd3MnVIXzdlUmR2QkxDVTlJeXZoYk54OV84ZktnazNQd0J6MnA3S3hiMElxbEdJU1dvUXRtREo1Q055X1ZMallkRlB1S1p4aTZ6UFJqVng4U3JiUDg4UzNOWGh5aVFJWWpQcTE4)]

Closing: The NBA offseason continues with veteran moves; Thomas' return could signal a front office or coaching role.

羽毛球.zh: 2026年新加坡公开赛正在进行，混双赛场出现争议：**纳西尔/艾哈迈德**（疑似印尼组合？实为Natsir L / Ahmad T）对阵**张楠/刘小龙**（原文有误，应为张楠/刘小龙？Sofascore显示是Zhang N / Liu X）的比赛中，裁判在局点出现争议判罚，被中国球迷称为“黑哨”，但“乐蒂组合”（猜测指马来西亚或中国组合？）申诉无效后强行逆转取胜，拿到开门红（[Mshale](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk)）。此外还有一场混双live score（[Sofascore](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQQ05mQ1JsdWozRW1ORHNGZlFzaWpMd0RnbVJ1Mm4ydTZ1VWdpOHNNQllVR01uRldxZEFjeExZel9QdDV3UEQ4S01jbi1NcjYwZHVja0I3N3NNWS1RRHVOUmlIdFZkM1AtSGZNblVCNlAzY3pUdnZRc0pJUTM1clVCdS1n)）。虽然具体选手身份存疑，但裁判争议再次引发对新加坡赛执法尺度的讨论。目前羽毛球单项赛程深入，后续值得关注国羽及马来西亚等队的表现。
羽毛球.en:
The Singapore Open badminton tournament saw a controversial line call in the first round, where the Malaysian women's doubles pair of Pearly Tan and Thinaah Muralitharan overcame a disputed 'black whistle' at match point to win. Additionally, a mixed doubles match between Natsir/Ahmad (Indonesia) and Zhang/Liu (China) is underway with live scores available.
- **Controversial call at Singapore Open**: The 'PearThin' duo (Malaysia) won despite a line judge call they considered unfair, showcasing resilience. [[Singapore Open controversy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk)]
- **Mixed doubles match**: Natsir/Ahmad vs Zhang/Liu ongoing; live score and H2H data available. [[Live score](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQQ05mQ1JsdWozRW1ORHNGZlFzaWpMd0RnbVJ1Mm4ydTZ1VWdpOHNNQllVR01uRldxZEFjeExZel9QdDV3UEQ4S01jbi1NcjYwZHVja0I3N3NNWS1RRHVOUmlIdFZkM1AtSGZNblVCNlAzY3pUdnZRc0pJUTM1clVCdS1n)]

Closing: The officiating debate adds tension to the tournament; fans will watch for consistency in subsequent rounds.

欧美.zh: 欧美娱乐今天被两股力量主导：一是流媒体生态的线下化尝试，Prime Video 的 Obsessed Fest 将《Elle》《Off Campus》《Every Year After》的卡司聚拢，并宣布《Every Year After》第二季将改编自原著续作《One Golden Summer》([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/every-year-after-season-2-renewed-charlie-1236796154/))；二是经典 IP 的续命动作——Rob Lowe 透露《St. Elmo's Fire》续集剧本已进入创作([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/rob-lowe-st-elmos-fire-sequel-script-in-works-1236969128/))。此外，Christopher Nolan 向 Ryan Coogler 传授 IMAX 拍摄经验，侧面印证了顶级导演间的技术互助文化([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/christopher-nolan-ryan-coogler-wasnt-crazy-sinners-imax-1236969143/))。Elon Musk 上架 Armie Hammer 德国禁片《Citizen Vigilante》48 小时后又下架，这一举动让 X 的「平台 vs 发行商」身份更加模糊([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/elon-musk-posts-armie-hammer-citizen-vigilante-1236796152/))。值得警惕的是 Jonh Hill 与 Kristen Wiig 的喜剧《Cut Off》被曝「不可发行」，项目前景堪忧([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/jonah-hill-cut-off-without-release-date-unreleasable-claim-1236632171/))。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk was dominated by Prime Video’s ecosystem play at Obsessed Fest, a wave of sequel and renewal announcements, and high-profile controversies around content distribution. The Nolan-Coogler IMAX mentorship and Vanilla Ice’s canceled White House gig added layers of industry dynamics and political interference.
- **Prime Video’s Obsessed Fest**: The streamer renewed [‘Every Year After’](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/every-year-after-season-2-renewed-charlie-1236796154/) for a second season (based on ‘One Golden Summer’) and teased [‘Overcompensating’ Season 2](https://deadline.com/2026/06/overcompensating-benito-skinner-plays-two-roles-season-2-1236969111/) with Benito Skinner playing dual roles. Jennifer Lopez made a surprise appearance to introduce [‘Off Campus’](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/jennifer-lopez-off-campus-obsessed-fest-1236632221/) – all signs of a deliberate YA romance universe.
- **Annecy 2027 Country of Honor: Colombia**: A strategic win for South American animation, this decision will funnel global attention and Mifa deals toward Colombian studios ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/global/colombia-2027-annecy-country-of-honor-1236795828/)).
- **Jonah Hill’s ‘Cut Off’ Stalled**: Despite Hill comparing it to ‘Step Brothers,’ the comedy with Kristen Wiig remains without release date amid “unreleasable” claims – a cautionary tale about studio confidence ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/jonah-hill-cut-off-without-release-date-unreleasable-claim-1236632171/)).
- **Elon Musk Streams Armie Hammer’s ‘Citizen Vigilante’**: The German-banned indie film was uploaded to X for 48 hours, a controversial move that bypassed traditional distribution and raised content moderation questions ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/elon-musk-armie-hammer-citizen-vigilante-stream-x-1236969093/)).
- **CNN Staff Braces for Bari Weiss Era**: As the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger nears, editor-in-chief Mark Thompson reportedly refused shared oversight, hinting at internal power struggles that could reshape CNN’s editorial direction ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/cnn-wary-bari-weiss-oversight-paramount-warner-bros-merger-1236632178/)).

Closing signal: With ‘Elle’ premiering July 1 and ‘Sinners’ still riding Oscar buzz, the next few weeks will test whether Prime Video’s fandom strategy translates to sustained viewership and whether political forces continue to reshape live performance programming.

日韩.zh: 日韩板块今日以偶像团体和人气剧集的数据突破为主。BTS 的《SWIM》在英获 BRIT 银认证，成为首支达成 13 首单曲银认证的韩国艺人([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850719wpp/bts-sets-uk-record-as-swim-becomes-their-13th-single-to-be-certified-brit-silver))；Jennie 与 Tame Impala 的《Dracula》在美国电台榜攀升至第 6 位，显示跨界合作的后劲([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850723wpp/jennie-and-tame-impalas-dracula-jumps-to-new-peak-on-billboard-radio-songs-chart))。新团 CORTIS 的《GREENGREEN》连续六周在 Billboard 200 在榜，创自身最长纪录([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850731wpp/cortiss-greengreen-becomes-their-longest-charting-album-on-billboard-200))。剧集方面，SBS《Agent Kim Reactivated》仅两集收视破 15%，成为近五年最快达到该成绩的迷你剧([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850715wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ratings-break-15-percent-in-2-episodes-making-it-fastest-drama-in-5-years-to-do-so))。恋情面，歌手 Jang Ki Ha 与演员 Yoon Ga Yi 经双方公司证实正在交往([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850709wpp/jang-ki-ha-and-yoon-ga-yi-confirmed-to-be-dating))。
日韩.en:
K-pop and K-drama continued their upward trajectory on global charts and domestic ratings. BTS set a UK record, Jennie & Tame Impala climbed Billboard radio, and ‘Agent Kim Reactivated’ broke ratings records in just two episodes. A new celebrity couple, Jang Ki Ha and Yoon Ga Yi, was confirmed, while variety shows and dance practice videos kept fan engagement high.
- **BTS Sets UK Record with ‘SWIM’**: The song earned BRIT Silver, making BTS the first Korean artist with 13 certified singles in the UK ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850719wpp/bts-sets-uk-record-as-swim-becomes-their-13th-single-to-be-certified-brit-silver)).
- **Jennie & Tame Impala’s ‘Dracula’ Hits No. 6 on Billboard Radio Songs**: The remix continues its steady climb across all genres, proving K-pop’s cross-over appeal ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850723wpp/jennie-and-tame-impalas-dracula-jumps-to-new-peak-on-billboard-radio-songs-chart)).
- **‘Agent Kim Reactivated’ Breaks 15% Ratings in 2 Episodes**: The fastest drama in 5 years to reach that threshold, starring So Ji Sub, signals strong audience appetite for revenge thrillers ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850715wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ratings-break-15-percent-in-2-episodes-making-it-fastest-drama-in-5-years-to-do-so)).
- **Jang Ki Ha and Yoon Ga Yi Confirmed Dating**: Both agencies confirmed the relationship, generating buzz and likely boosting visibility for their projects ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850709wpp/jang-ki-ha-and-yoon-ga-yi-confirmed-to-be-dating)).
- **CORTIS’s ‘GREENGREEN’ Charts 6th Week on Billboard 200**: The EP sets a personal record for the group, showing sustained international interest ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850731wpp/cortiss-greengreen-becomes-their-longest-charting-album-on-billboard-200)).

Closing signal: The combination of record-breaking singles, rapid drama ratings, and celebrity romance will keep Korean entertainment in the crosshairs of global fans; watch for ‘Agent Kim Reactivated’ to potentially hit 20% ratings next week.

中国.zh: 今晚「CMG 中国影视之夜」是绝对焦点。迪丽热巴与吴越共同获封年度电视剧女演员，黄渤拿下年度电影男演员，主流奖项的「双黄蛋」体现了评委会对不同类型表演的平衡考量([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE41dmZrbnFVVHYzc0N6ZWd0VEUtMmlvbUswZWJTOWxsT3ZsR0MtTmR3SjR3UER6amZ3TjdqczJCYXRoNGZ6dHdPU01jNXF0aFlJQ0p5Ry1xeC1laWdRX3A2SHFqTzNVaGo4QktwaW8wQkE))。第十届中国-新西兰电影嘉年华同日开幕，聚焦影视合作新机遇([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNS01LUjhXbGhwOVItVzFiZzg4U1VhZ0EzUGYwdVFDQ2JwSTlJd0xCaDFUY19lcjk4QVZNWm41dFNYTlowc2lKOHVyMzBOeVdJOER1Q0R5NnBLLWp0OUJ5QlhRU3pzVnJERHg5WjRxS3ZzVktITEZibXJxRkJTMnVjYXpaTEFiRENOUndpZg))。值得一提的是，央视《焦点访谈》专题报道「文化新三样」出海，将影视、游戏、网文列为中国软实力输出的新名片([杭州网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNb1hUbFFpbWFuUWxUaUdSdEQ3aHBxUzNnM19tTHN4RlRTam90Q0hSRkpfcmxZdzJPWGdYRmRTWnJGV0Ntekl4TFlLaGJqdTNsRXhaQ0VTbndMWENvbFp3UzBXd19SazlWdjFDVjAtdHk2ZjZWNmlOZnphR3pTMS1KamQ5WUc))，娱乐产业的政策面信号积极。
中国.en:
China’s entertainment scene was focused on the CMG China Film & TV Night awards, where Dilraba Dilmurat and Wu Yue won Best TV Actress, and Huang Bo took Best Film Actor. The event also highlighted cultural exports like the “new three samples” (games, short dramas, web novels). A China-New Zealand film festival opened, fostering co-production discussions.
- **Dilraba Dilmurat and Wu Yue Win CMG Best TV Actress**: Both were recognized at the prestigious event, underscoring their commercial and critical appeal ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE41dmZrbnFVVHYzc0N6ZWd0VEUtMmlvbUswZWJTOWxsT3ZsR0MtTmR3SjR3UER6amZ3TjdqczJCYXRoNGZ6dHdPU01jNXF0aFlJQ0p5Ry1xeC1laWdRX3A2SHFqTzNVaGo4QktwaW8wQkE)).
- **Huang Bo Wins CMG Best Film Actor**: A veteran actor recognized for his consistent box-office draw ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFA2bWtLRVI1VTdETmtXSTR6d1M0MXJQcC1ha1phZ1M2N1l3Y05tWFNIRU5VNjU4Vm1TdndzNVZVTE1zMy00UEg4dk1ZMDFXWnVVWlkyZU5RQm0yaVV5Rk1CdmthVy1CT1VFRHhyR0R6MGY)).
- **China-New Zealand Film Festival Opens**: The 10th edition aims to foster cross-border cooperation, with potential implications for co-productions and market access ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNS01LUjhXbGhwOVItVzFiZzg4U1VhZ0EzUGYwdVFDQ2JwSTlJd0xCaDFUY19lcjk4QVZNWm41dFNYTlowc2lKOHVyMzBOeVdJOER1Q0R5NnBLLWp0OUJ5QlhRU3pzVnJERHg5WjRxS3ZzVktITEZibXJxRkJTMnVjYXpaTEFiRENOUndpZg)).
- **Focus Interview on Cultural Exports**: CCTV highlighted “new three samples” (games, short dramas, web novels) as rising soft-power tools ([Hangzhou Net](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNb1hUbFFpbWFuUWxUaUdSdEQ3aHBxUzNnM19tTHN4RlRTam90Q0hSRkpfcmxZdzJPWGdYRmRTWnJGV0Ntekl4TFlLaGJqdTNsRXhaQ0VTbndMWENvbFp3UzBXd19SazlWdjFDVjAtdHk2ZjZWNmlOZnphR3pTMS1KamQ5WUc)).

Closing signal: The CMG awards reinforce the dominance of established stars, while the focus on cultural exports signals Beijing’s intent to promote Chinese content globally; the New Zealand festival could be a bellwether for international co-productions.

微博社区动态.zh: 微博今日热点呈现「娱乐+社会」交织的特点。肖战在CMG影视之夜误以为奖杯需要回收、当场递还的瞬间被剪辑传播，话题#肖战递奖杯# 登榜，讨论量超 3 亿，粉丝称赞其「真性情」，路人则认为「可爱但又心酸」([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPZkhkWHNCbGdYVDUtS210ZXdNV2V2RHl0enlZWkw2bkFKaGhXOEhWSUVKLS1jNlZodElra1VLZV8zRDlzRXNSQjZVVUxsWng2eEZSVHNQaVdHWkMybzZUR0w1cVpGek9iYWxIb01pT25ZN2poUXF6dHc1eE9oTEFCZWJtenk))。白鹿洋娃娃造型出处被粉丝挖出，进一步带动《莫离》番外热度([新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1zZW0zUVVvNEw5WTVfREJUVDQ4aUMtSVdZelA4UTIxU0cxV0JGdEx6bnpfQlZkaWk0eTRPRmM5TGNKVk1jaFZxanF5TVV2aEJoS1pwek5VanFhN3EySFFpVkVOdDlwWnYwMlZGVzFoRk9QZw))。《浪姐7》总决赛完整视频上线，但讨论度被肖战盖过。此外，#韩国队被全世界针对# 因世界杯排名下滑成为热搜，折射体育话题对娱乐版块的侵蚀。王橹杰仅发两字泡泡便引爆粉丝猜论，显示新生代爱豆与粉丝之间极低的互动阈值([新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxONEJjM2hVbmRrZEFWU1pEQUw1STg0S19FZUtJNEhYenVUTlZTeTF2ODRLSTZZd0ZTaGI1RHM1bkV5Vm9EdkRYN3U4UHBaTUxqbHp3LTRxZWpkdjdfbE03ajRDeExLSG82SENvSVlkcFBrQ3hPUU9ZQWNXZlBYd09FUFVWZjV0ckt0bkRMbFZsRWFEMWZBcEFUNDVweDBoSUltakhNRlVQaw))。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo was buzzing with a mix of entertainment and sports crossover topics. A viral moment saw actor Xiao Zhan mistakenly try to return an award trophy, while Dilraba Dilmurat’s fans rallied support. The hashtag “Korea being targeted by the whole world” trended after World Cup rankings dropped. Pan Wei-bo’s quick reaction also made headlines. Fan speculation about Wang Lujie’s two-character post and a dog playing dead incident added to the platform’s signature blend of whimsy and fandom.
- **Xiao Zhan’s Award Return Moment**: The 34-year-old actor’s innocent gesture of handing back a trophy because he thought it needed to be returned went viral, sparking widespread affection and meme creation ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPZkhkWHNCbGdYVDUtS210ZXdNV2V2RHl0enlZWkw2bkFKaGhXOEhWSUVKLS1jNlZodElra1VLZV8zRDlzRXNSQjZVVUxsWng2eEZSVHNQaVdHWkMybzZUR0w1cVpGek9iYWxIb01pT25ZN2poUXF6dHc1eE9oTEFCZWJtenk)).
- **“Korea Being Targeted” Trends**: After World Cup rankings shifted, the hashtag reflected nationalist sentiment among Chinese netizens, triggered by Korea’s failing qualification hopes ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5qZG1scHFRTVdXbnc2VVFxc01Qc2Rza2xKei1SeC1YSm83Zk80ekkzVm1Bbm90YnZ5amxUOVhlb1FrcFBaYVpaSWRYRldZVHo4TFlKMWJuRUhPbjViUmJDa2RFTQ)).
- **Dilraba Fan Support Surges**: Following her CMG award win, fans amplified her achievements on Weibo, demonstrating the star’s massive digital footprint ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE43MWl4S0otNmhVN1BnckFDSmNkRlVEeVJGNFZITFE0SGc2WFFMMUpSLXUzS0dFclNrUktsbFZaYXFna0VwMGZpamEyVlZ6WnBZSmI5d2FrcHo0MDNLRFZLZEFYMA)).
- **Pan Wei-bo’s Quick Reaction Trends**: The singer’s swift response to an unspecified event grabbed attention, becoming a topic of discussion about celebrity authenticity ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBiZl9malJ0X3J0aTVlOTVaU282X2lEVzVkZEo3MU1EUWV3TXV5VmpfX0NEUVYtYUxEVTVCaUxSZTlPUWxXT0VKTERrc1ExRkpRcGtSSEVzMW9rUlZhOUxyMnd4NDBueUt1NGY1TzBSU0Rxdw)).

Closing signal: The weibo ecosystem continues to amplify both celebrity charm and nationalist sports sentiment; the Xiao Zhan moment is likely to sustain engagement for days, while the Korea hashtag may fade unless the World Cup math changes.
